overview.en: Teen spy Cody Banks poses as a music student to infiltrate an elite London boarding school to catch an evil scientist who has stolen a mind-control device.

title.en: Number One on the Call Sheet

overview.en: Some of Hollywood’s biggest stars reveal their journeys to game-changing leading roles. In candid interviews, they shine a light on the highs and lows of their craft, breakthrough moments, blueprints for success, and the next generation’s huge potential.

overview.de: Die wilden Party-Mamas um Mila Kunis und Kristen Bell ordern die nächste Runde: In der Fortsetzung des exzessiven Comedy-Hits lassen sie es nun unter dem Weihnachtsbaum krachen.
overview.en: Our three under-appreciated and over-burdened women rebel against the challenges and expectations of Christmas, all while hosting their own mothers.
A new neighbor sets out to put so many Christmas lights on his house that they'll be seen in space.
An ex-con and Vietnam vet's attempt to run a straight business has him locking horns with both the law and the mafia in this tale of revenge.

Teenage genius Luke Ellis is abducted by The Institute, a secret organization that takes kids with psychic powers for use in a mysterious project. The place is run by Ms. Sigsby, a sadistic true believer who engages Luke in a deadly battle of wills.
Meet Riley, a bunny with a big imagination who loves crafting worlds with just one box.

Selected for Official Competition at the Cannes Film Festival, TALE OF TALES is an epic vision of cinema from Matteo Garrone (Gomorrah), inspired by the Italian fairytales of medieval Naples. From the bitter quest of a jealous Queen (Salma Hayek) who forfeits the life of her husband, to two mysterious sisters who provoke the passion of a King (Vincent Cassel), to a King obsessed with a giant Flea
Based on the book by master spy novelist John LeCarre, a British publisher and a Russian editor get sucked into the deadly world of espionage.
6-year-old Susan meets Kriss Kringle, a department store Santa who thinks he's the genuine article.

overview.de: Die Leinwandlegenden Clint Eastwood und Jeff Bridges spielen in diesem mutigen, witzigen und actiongeladenen Krimi ein modernes Gesetzlosenpaar. Auf den Fersen von Thunderbolt und Lightfoot sind George Kennedy und Geoffrey Lewis.
overview.en: While fleeing from a theft, a drifter meets a legendary criminal who's also on the run. The duo reunite with their old partners to plan a bank heist.
The true story of childhood friends from affluent American families who decide to betray their country by selling government secrets to the Russians.
A reformed outlaw is left abandoned in a remote area after he intervenes in a train robbery, where he unexpectedly runs into his old gang.
The bumbling Inspector Jacques Clouseau tries to catch an infamous jewel thief before he can steal a priceless diamond from a princess.

title.en: The Return of the Pink Panther

overview.en: Dispatched to a Swiss resort town, Clouseau must investigate cat-burglar Sir Charles and his wife Claudine through a series of hilarious disguises.

title.de: Die letzte Nacht des Boris Gruschenko

overview.en: Woody Allen hilariously invades the spirit of Tolstoy in this spoof of 18th Century Russia, when a cowardly scholar (Allen) settles down with he beautiful Sonja (Diane Keaton) for life rich in philosophy...and a zany plot to assassinate Napoleon!
In this true WWII story, an American colonel creates the First Special Service Force from a group of misfits. A dangerous mission soon awaits.

overview.de: Country superstar Liam Page (Alex Roe) left Josie (Jessica Rothe) at the altar 8 years ago, choosing fame and fortune instead. When he returns to his hometown for the funeral of a friend, he is faced with the consequences of all he left behind.
overview.en: A country music star returns to his hometown and reunites with the bride that he left at the altar.
A desperate young girl and her little brother stumble upon a nexus of terrifying evil when they venture into a dark wood in search of food and work.
After narrowly escaping death, a man mistaken for a killer takes on the job of deputy marshal to bring justice to the men who did him wrong.

title.en: In the Heat of the Night

overview.en: While traveling in the deep south, a black Philadelphian homicide detective becomes embroiled in a murder investigation.

title.de: Inspektor Clouseau - Der irre Flic mit dem heißen Blick

overview.en: The ever-bungling Inspector Clouseau dodges bombs, bullets, karate chops, and his own blundering screw-ups — much to Chief Inspector Dreyfus' dismay.
When a cop is framed for murder and chained to a felon, the duo make a break for it, trying to stay a step ahead of the law and the real killer.
Follow Goldie as she shakes up her beloved town of Boysenberg with her best friends.
A trio of trouble outcasts set out from Timbuktu on a punishing quest to unearth a lost city and treasure buried deep inside the Sahara desert.
Three astronauts return from Mars, unaware that something has boarded the ship with its sights on Earth.
A comedy-fantasy about a Depression-era movie fan/waitress whose day-to-day existence is enlivened when her latest idol walks right off the screen and into her life!

overview.de: Ein Computerfreak hackt sich zufällig in das Kriegssystem der USA ein und muss Schlimmes verhindern.
overview.en: A teen (Matthew Broderick) taps into NORAD and plays global war.
A computer hacker participating in a government terrorist attack simulation game unknowingly engages a paranoid supercomputer that deems him a threat.

overview.de: Wie eine weibliche Version von "Hangover": Die "Bad Moms" hauen mit deftigen Gags ordentlich auf den Putz. - Amy (Mila Kunis) hatte einen stressigen Tag: Der Hund muss zum Arzt, sie hat sich mit Kaffee überschüttet und ihrer Tochter das erste Fußballtraining versaut. Da kommt ihr die Kuchen-Polizei um Elternbeirätin Gwendolyn (Christina Applegate) auch noch mit irren Zutaten-Verboten quer. Amys neue Devise: Bad Moms statt Vorzeige-Mütter! Mit ihren Freundinnen (Kathryn Hahn, Kristen Bell) schaltet sie in den Party-Modus - doch die Vorzeige-Hausfrauen schlagen umgehend zurück.
overview.en: Three overworked, overcommitted, and stressed-out moms join forces on a quest to liberate themselves from conventional responsibilities.

overview.de: Captain Flint und seine Männer wollen die sagenumwobene "Urca de Lima" kapern. An Bord dieser spanischen Galeone soll sich ein unermesslicher Schatz befinden.
overview.en: A STARZ original series, the pirate adventure BLACK SAILS, centers on the tales of Captain Flint and his notorious crew as they fight for fortune and survival prior to the events portrayed in the book "Treasure Island."

title.de: Bread & Roses: A Fight for Women's Rights

overview.en: In the wake of the Taliban’s return to power, a group of Kabul women lead a fight for their rights—and their lives.
Discover the story of the greatest civil rights movement most have never heard about.

overview.de: Zweimal lebenslänglich - diese Strafe muss Bankier Andy Dufresne (Tim Robbins) für den Mord an seiner Frau und deren Liebhaber in dem berüchtigten Gefängnis von Shawshank verbüßen, obwohl er stets seine Unschuld beteuerte. Der Knast-Alltag ist extrem hart. Die sadistischen Gefängniswärter und der selbstherrliche Direktor Norton (Bob Gunton) schikanieren die Gefangenen bis aufs Äußerste. Andy er...
overview.en: A man is thrown into the brutality of prison life when he gets two life sentences for a crime he claims he didn't commit. Drama starring Tim Robbins and Morgan Freeman. (1995)(142 mins)

overview.de: Nach dem Verschwinden ihrer Schwester flieht Jax (Lily Gladstone) vor dem Gesetz und tritt mit ihrer Nichte eine Reise an.
overview.en: Following her sister’s disappearance, Jax (Lily Gladstone) and her niece Roki must stick together. Desperate to keep what’s left of their family intact, Jax and Roki defy the law and hit the road on a journey to the Grand Nation Powwow in Oklahoma City.
Henry Hill, a poor Irish-Italian rises through the ranks of an organized crime branch.

overview.de: Ein Medikament verwandelt Menschen in Vampire. Nur ein Mensch überlebt, um gegen sie zu kämpfen.
overview.en: In a post-apocalyptic New York City ravaged by plague, a brilliant scientist appears to be the sole human survivor battling vampire-like mutants.

title.en: Rabbit Without Ears and Two-Eared Chick

overview.de: Neo. Trinity. Morpheus. Im atemberaubenden letzten Kapitel der Matrix-Trilogie stehen sie und die übrigen Helden am Rande von Sieg oder Vernichtung im ultimativen Kampf gegen die Maschinen.
overview.en: In this explosive final chapter of the Matrix trilogy, Neo, Morpheus and Trinity battle to defend Zion, the last real-world city, against the onslaught of the machines that have enslaved the human race. And, now as Neo learns more about his heroic powers--including the ability to see the codes of things and the people, he faces the consequences of the choice made in The Matrix Reloaded.

Dr Addison Montgomery is a neonatal surgeon who moves to Los Angeles to join a private practice. Addison and her co-workers have to deal with patients and the practice while still finding time to live their lives.
A 17-year-old embarks on a quest to find her missing father, navigating life while pursuing her dream of becoming a pro hockey player.
Detectives probe a series of baffling murders based on the seven deadly sins.

overview.de: In fünfzig Jahren stirbt die Sonne - und mit ihr stirbt auch die Menschheit. Unsere letzte Hoffnung: ein Raumschiff, die Icarus II, mit einer internationalen Crew von acht Frauen und Männern. Unter Führung von Kapitän Kaneda soll das Team eine Sprengladung zur Sonne bringen, mit der sie den lebenswichtigen Stern wieder entzünden wollen. Es ist die letzte Chance der Menschheit zu überleben.
overview.en: A team of international astronauts is sent on a dangerous mission to reignite the dying Sun in 2057.

overview.de: Im Kampf um den Fortbestand der ganzen Welt taucht der Protagonist in die zwielichtige Welt internationaler Spionage ein. Seine Mission? Völlig von der Zeit losgelöst.
overview.en: A secret agent embarks on a dangerous, time-bending mission to prevent the start of World War III.
Lali Sokolov, a Holocaust survivor and former tattooist at Auschwitz concentration camp, shares a remarkable story of love, trauma and resilience.

Sawyer (Amanda Payton) makes a fake wedding registry. But when the whole town throws her a surprise bridal shower, she's too embarrassed to tell the truth. Instead, she finds a fake fiance to help her navigate through the lies and holiday festivities.
A psychotic killer challenges his victim to a chess match.
In a dry, thirsty New Mexico town, a Latino family finds hope in an extraordinary little boy, who finds a ukulele and begins to perform miracles.
In this parody of WWII movies, Sgt. Duke and his ragtag unit are on a mission that could end the war, that is, if they don’t mess it up first.
A struggling designer becomes stylist to a grumpy billionaire. As fashion meets business, sparks fly and they discover they might be the perfect fit.

title.en: The Little Murders of Agatha Christie

overview.en: Agatha Christie's mysteries are adapted in a new series of movies! Set in the 1930s, these stories introduce two new investigators in classic Christie style: Superintendent Larosière, whose passion for beautiful women is matched only by his love of solving puzzling crimes, and his young colleague Inspector Lampion, whose modern sensibilities sometimes clash with those of a less-enlightened age.

A modern adaptation of the classic children's story "Alice Through the Looking Glass" by Lewis Carroll and John Tenniel, which continued on from "Alice's Adventures in Wonderland". This time, Alice is played by the mother, who falls asleep while reading the bedtime story to her daughter. Walking through the Looking Glass, Alice (Kate Beckinsale) finds herself in Chessland, a magical and fun world.

Family dynamics take a messy turn when a woman learns she has a half sister at her mother's funeral. As her perfect life starts to unravel, she suspects her new sister is to blame for her mom's death.
Murky secrets about a popular high schooler's death come to light when a group of her best friends reunite for their annual camping trip.

title.de: Amazon Music Live: Wu-Tang Clan, Nas, and De La Soul's 'N.Y. State of Mind Tour'
title.en: Amazon Music Live: Wu-Tang Clan, Nas, and De La Soul's 'N.Y. State of Mind Tour'

overview.en: Wu-Tang and Nas unite once again for a joint tour along with an appearance by De La Soul. Watch the iconic hip-hop event, recorded live from the Climate Pledge Arena. Don't miss a moment with Amazon Music Live
Army Ranger Joe Armstrong travels to a remote Caribbean island to save his friend from a criminal mastermind and his army of mutant ninja warriors.
The demonic forces that haunted the infamous Long Island house escape through a mystical lamp to California, where evil manipulates a little girl.
A motorcycle club of Bosnian War survivors heal their trauma with a charity drive for their town and to protect the wild horses they met in battle.
The fascinating true story of the woman who claimed to be the sole survivor of the Romanov royal family murders during the Russian Revolution.
Alive at 40 is a stand-up special by Anuvab Pal, talking about what it is like to be in a 40 year old entertainer in 'New India', where people are pretending to be hip and failing disgracefully.

overview.de: Action mit Sylvester Stallone als Gangster: Rook überfällt mit seiner Bande einen Geldtransporter mit Millionen Dollar an Bord. Doch er hat die Rechnung ohne die beiden Fahrer gemacht.
overview.en: A father and son working as armed guards for an armored truck company join forces to outgun and outwit a group of would-be robbers.

title.de: Auf der Flucht - Das Geheimnis des Mädchens vom See

overview.en: Los detectives angelinos MInelli y Blake deben encontrar a un violador que pudiera saber quién es el loco que anda plantando bombas por todas partes.
After a mixup, a science wiz lands at an Australian soccer academy, where she’ll have to make friends and avoid bullies while learning a new sport.
Recruited by a despotic general and cartel kingpin, the Panther Squad of martial artists abducts a renowned explorer seeking a priceless artifact.

title.de: Be Cool - Jeder ist auf der Suche nach dem nächsten großen Hit

overview.en: Chili Palmer turns to the world of rock stars, pop divas, and hip hop gangstas when a new idea for a movie leads him into the music business.
Living in Malaysia long after World War II, a U.S. soldier is forced to turn in an old friend who has allied with Communist-backed guerilla forces.
In early 20th-century Chinatown, an adventurer gets embroiled in an underworld dispute while trying to rescue women from trafficking.
A city mouse and his friends stow away on a ship headed for Dream Island, hoping to save their families from a sinister white weasel.

It’s summertime and Bibi and Tina are looking forward to camping out in the tents at Falkenstein. A bunch of students from an international partner school will be joining in on the fun. The highlight will be a geocaching challenge – a 21st century treasure hunt – and this time, it’s boys vs. girls. But ambitious young Urs will use every dirty trick in the book to win.
Set in Los Angeles during a decade of excess, a group of wealthy young men discover that their money-making plan spirals into deadly consequences.

Eddy Storkowitz is an imaginative, inquisitive and precocious ten year old bird.  Through his eyes, we discover a world in which human qualities are endowed upon our fine feathered friends.  Birdz characters work in places like The Worm Factory, eat at the nearby Fly-Through Restaurant and retire at the Home For Endangered Species.  Join Eddy and his family in 13 hilarious episodes of animated comedy.

title.de: Black Robe - Am Fluß der Irokesen

overview.en: The epic story and personal reckoning of a Catholic missionary, called Black Robe, trying to settle in with an Iroquois tribe in 17th century Canada.

Three wives in three unhappy marriages come up with a deadly scheme: killing off their three husbands in a boat explosion. But what begins as a simple triple-murder ends up tangling Veera, Kirsi and Johanna in a web of their own making.

overview.de: Mitten auf dem Time Square in New York City entsteigt eine wunderschöne junge Frau mit einem großflächigen Tattoo einer Reisetasche - ohne sich erinnern zu können, wie sie in diese Situation gelangte. Ihr Tattoo ist ein Hinweis auf einen FBI-Agenten, der sich des Falles annimmt. Gemeinsam versuchen Opfer und Experten, das Rätsel um die Herkunft und Identität der jungen Frau zu klären, und geraten mitten in eine internationale Verschwörung, die sich um eine Reihe mysteriöser Verbrechen dreht.
overview.en: A vast international plot explodes when a mysterious Jane Doe is discovered in Times Square, covered in cryptic tattoos with no memory of who she is. But there's one tattoo that’s impossible to miss: the name of FBI agent Kurt Weller, on her back. Soon, Weller and his FBI team realize that each mark on her body is a crime to solve, leading them closer to the truth about her identity.

overview.de: Zwei Zwillingsbrüder (beide gespielt von Michael B. Jordan) kehren in ihre Heimatstadt zurück, um neu anzufangen. Doch dort müssen sie feststellen, dass das Böse geradezu auf sie gewartet hat. „Tanze weiter mit dem Teufel und eines Tages folgt er dir nach Hause.“
overview.en: Trying to leave their troubled lives behind, twin brothers return to their Mississippi hometown to start again, only to discover that an even greater evil is waiting to welcome them back.

title.de: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids
title.en: Blood Hunters: Rise of the Hybrids

overview.en: An Aswang, hybrid, and demon hunters unite to battle powerful underworld warlords. They face a twisted trap and fight for survival in this intense encounter.
A family shattered by the death of a son is wickedly manipulated by the mysterious young woman who turns up claiming to be his former girlfriend.

title.de: Bonnie & Clyde - Amerikas berühmtestes Gangsterpaar / Die wahre Geschichte

overview.en: Bonnie Parker and Clyde Barrow were the most famous criminal couple in US history. In reality, as this film reveals, Bonnie and Clyde grew up in the slums of West Dallas and had little in common with their glamorous media images.
The daily adventures of a boy named Boule and his spaniel Bill. The two begin a great friendship until trouble brews with Billy's parents.
The teen action classic about a group of troublesome students from an exclusive prep school who defend it when Colombian terrorists lay siege to it.

BRAZEN HUSSIES reveals a revolutionary chapter in Australian history, the Women's Liberation Movement (1965 - 1975). Interweaving freshly uncovered archival footage, personal photos, memorabilia, and lively personal accounts from activists, BRAZEN HUSSIES shows us how a daring and diverse group of women joined forces to defy the status quo, demand equality, and create profound social change
In this dark folk thriller, a couple, struggling to fix their doomed relationship, gets lost in a dangerous forest that refuses to let them escape.

title.de: Bruce Lee - Gigant des Kung Fu

overview.en: This Bruce Lee biopic traces his life from college to his fascination with martial arts and development of Jeet Kune Do to his untimely death.

title.de: Butterfly Tale - Ein Abenteuer liegt in der Luft

overview.en: Having one wing isn’t going to stop Patrick the Monarch butterfly and his best friend Jennifer from embarking on the adventure of a lifetime and conquering their fears together.
In rural Brazil, a family haunted by its history of cannibalism experiences increasingly intense violent madness across multiple generations.
In the jungles of Colombia, a photojournalist captures the truth behind a group of missionaries who may not be what they seem.

title.de: Cannabis: Der große Hype um Hanf
title.en: Cannabis : quand le deal est légal

overview.en: College student Ashley gets abducted by Samuel, a crazed religious fundamentalist who attempts to force a change in her as she struggles to escape.

Casanova (David Tennant) takes us from the decadent streets of the 18th Century Venice to the salons of pre-revolution Paris, and on to the London courts of George III, until a trip to Naples finally breaks Casanova's heart. In the Age of Reason and Science, gambling and gallantries, of pleasure and entertainment, Casanova has it all, does it all.
The Manson Family women recount the crimes and murders they committed in service of their cult leader in Mary Harron's provocative take on one of the most infamous crimes in the 20th century.
In this drama based on a popular webtoon, a working class college girl embarks on a relationship with a sociopath who feels love for the first time.
The adventures of two California Highway Patrol motorcycle officers, as they cruise the freeways of Los Angeles, solve crimes and help people in trouble.

title.en: Cold Case Files: The Rifkin Murders

overview.en: "Cold Case Files: The Rifkin Murders" documents the real-time New York State Police cold case investigation into the two unidentified victims of serial killer Joel Rifkin, the most prolific serial killer in New York State history.

title.de: Columbus Day - Ein Spiel auf Leben und Tod

overview.en: A jaded thief (Val Kilmer) pulls off the biggest heist of his career, but he must race to unload the merchandise if he is to make all the money he needs to get out of the criminal life for good.
Seeking reconciliation with her husband, a woman is led through a disorderly ritual involving a strange pandit and five diverse participants.
Two geeky best friends overcome a humiliating prank by uniting all the high school outcasts, bringing a whole new meaning to being popular.

title.de: Crazy Christmas - Weihnachten bei Santa Claus

overview.en: A slice-of-life drama intertwining the plight and individual stories of various foreign immigrants trying to become U.S. citizens in Los Angeles.
A nutty antiques dealer starts to sacrifice women to an African idol, Chuku, whom he believes will provide him with immense wealth and power.
An investigator teams up with a profiler to investigate the mysterious disappearances of a number of young women.
When love stops being a two-way street, a couple must decide if it takes two wrongs to make a right or if they can make a change before it’s too late.
Un agente de inteligencia que busca a una mujer sospechosa de chantajear a un alto funcionario del gobierno queda fascinado y obsesionado con ella.

What if you found out that your three closest friends are enemy agents? For John Tanner, the news comes on the eve of a reunion weekend. But as the reunion turns deadly, is John being set up for the most shocking betrayal of all?

After her fiancé cheats, Cristina looks for a new roommate and finds Alejandro, who she welcomes into her home because she thinks he’s gay. By the time Alejandro tells her the truth, it’s too late and they’re already in love with each other.
When Alyson starts exploring the home left to her by her estranged father, she uncovers some very dark secrets hiding in her family's past.

Sid Straw (Tony Hale) leads a dull life until he accidentally stalks famous college friend, Elizabeth Banks, on social media. With each failed attempt to prove he knows her, he rediscovers more of himself and the true meaning of friendship.

title.de: Death House - Gefangen in der Hölle

overview.en: When an outside force shuts down a futuristic maximum security prison, two FBI agents get trapped with the most evil people on the face of the Earth.
An accountant becomes the suspect in a woman's disappearance and a multimillion-dollar heist.

overview.de: Auf der Suche nach Hilfe für ihre Großmutter wird Defne Zeugin einer Beerdigung, die die Gefahr zu ihr nach Hause bringt.
overview.en: Seeking help for her grandmother, Defne witnesses a burial that brings danger home.

This nine-part series is the work that made documentarian Ken Burns a household name. Burns uses contemporary cinematography alongside thousands of archival photographs, paintings, and newspaper images set to music to teach people about the American Civil War. A number of well-known actors and actresses lend their voices to the production as they read contemporary quotes from historical figures, including President Abraham Lincoln and General Stonewall Jackson.

Two CIA agents and ex-lovers (Chris Pine and Thandiwe Newton) are brought back together years after a failed rescue attempt and forced to blur the lines between profession and passion in this deeply riveting tale of global espionage, moral dilemma and deadly betrayal.

title.de: Der Anschlag - Wettlauf gegen die Zeit

overview.en: A thief (John Travolta) works with his father (Christopher Plummer) and son to forge a painting by Monet and steal the original. Together, they plan the heist of their lives!
On another planet in the distant past, a Gelfling embarks on a quest to find the missing shard of a magical crystal and restore order to his world.

overview.de: Der Film basiert auf dem Bestseller des erfolgreichen Autors Stephen King. Revolvermann Roland Deschain (IDRIS ELBA) ist der letzte seiner Art und gefangen in einem ewigen Kampf mit Walter O’Dim, auch bekannt als der Mann in Schwarz (MATTHEW MCCONAUGHEY). Roland ist fest entschlossen, ihn daran zu hindern, den Dunklen Turm zu Fall zu bringen, der das ganze Universum zusammenhält. Das Schicksal...
overview.en: Roland Deschain (Idris Elba), the last Gunslinger, is locked in an eternal battle with Walter O'Dim (Matthew McConaughey), also known as the Man in Black. The Gunslinger must prevent the Man in Black from toppling the Dark Tower.

Roberto Rossellini’s Golden Lion winner at Venice 1959 is a moving wartime masterpiece. Vittorio De Sica plays a small-time conman imprisoned by the Nazis and coerced into impersonating a resistance hero. As he gains the trust of fellow prisoners, deception gives way to conviction. Based on real events, it’s a stirring reflection on identity, courage, and redemption under fascist rule.

Based on the story of the Bell Witch of Tennessee, An American Haunting tells the story of a spirit which attacked the wealthy and highly respected Bell family for four years, eventually causing the death of one of its family members.

title.de: Der Held ohne Klasse: Der Aufstieg eines Talentlosen
title.en: Hero Without a Class: Who Even Needs Skills?!

overview.de: Im Alter von zehn Jahren wird jedem Kind eine Klasse zugewiesen, die seine Fähigkeiten und seine Zukunft bestimmt. Arel passt sonderbarerweise in...
overview.en: In a world where one's class determines everything, Arel, the son of a Sword Princess and an Archmage, discovers he's classless. Now, he's determined to prove that hard work and dedication are enough to succeed, and to excel as an adventurer!
On the moors of Southwestern England, Holmes must solve the case of an ancient hound supposedly killing off a family of local nobility.

In The Twelve Gold Medallions, Yueh Hua plays a knight trying to stop the invading Chins. Although he knows the secret of how do it, obstacles abound. Yueh went on to star in Jackie Chan's Rumble In The Bronx.
Tan Tung flees to San Francisco to escape gang trouble at home, but when he finds the same men in the city, he plots an inside job to take them out.

Having spent a lifetime concealing his heritage, an aging German Holocaust survivor tries to come to terms with his past. Born Menachem Teitelbaum, Marcus Schwarz (German Academy Award winner Mario Adorf) escaped Auschwitz with his life only to exterminate his Jewishness. Without family, a synagogue or a single Jewish friend, the hardened old man has so effectively created a new identity that, when faced with his own mortality, the rabbis refuse his appeal to be buried in a Jewish cemetery in Cologne. Determined to return to his birthplace and establish his ancestry, Marcus enlists the help of Gül (Katharina Derr), a brash, chain-smoking Turkish woman with a troubled history of her own. The unlikely duo sets out on a road trip to a small village on the Hungarian-Romanian border, a journey that will irrevocably change them both.
In this Tennessee Williams masterpiece, a paradoxical drifter is drawn into the desperate lives of two passionate women in a small Mississippi town.
A streetwise teenager enrolls in a suburban high school where he finds support from a group of believers. But not everyone can look beyond his past.

overview.de: Der unschätzbar wertvolle Pink Panther wurde gestohlen und nur Frankreichs größter Detektiv, Inspektor Clouseau, kann ihn wiederfinden.
overview.en: When a star soccer coach is murdered and his priceless Pink Panther diamond stolen, bumbling Inspector Clouseau (Steve Martin) is on the case! With his partner, Gilbert Ponton (Jean Reno), he jumps from one hilarious misadventure to the next.

overview.de: Der tollpatschige Inspektor Clouseau wird Teil einer internationalen Ermittlungstruppe, die den Beutezügen des Kunstdiebs Tornado ein Ende bereiten soll.
overview.en: Inspector Clouseau joins a team of international detectives to track a globe-trotting thief, but his chaotic methods threaten the mission.

overview.de: Die Gefahr von Sturm und Wellen auf hoher See ist ihr Alltag, für einenerfolgreichen Fischzug geben sie alles - die Schwertfischer von Gloucester riskieren täglich ihr Leben und sind stolz darauf! Aber als Captain Tyne und seine Crew dieses Mal auslaufen, um den letzten Fang der Saison einzuholen, ahnen sie nicht, welcher Macht sie sich stellen müssen ...
overview.en: George Clooney leads the crew of a fishing vessel through a colossal storm in this action blockbuster. Mark Wahlberg.

title.de: Der weiße Apache - Die Rache des Halbbluts

overview.en: A Native American tribe raises a white baby who was the sole survivor of a murdered group of settlers. As he grows up, he is torn between two worlds.
Wild Bill Hickok and Crazy Horse, two legendary figures, head out on a quest for the demon albino buffalo in this haunting western tale.

A Hallmark Channel original movie. After swearing off dating for a full year and trying to focus on her career as an aspiring meteorologist, Leah quickly learns her new commitment has made her a magnet for men. She befriends her neighbour Mark, who teaches her the importance of listening to nature, as well as her heart.

title.de: Der Würger kommt auf leisen Socken

overview.de: Aus dem Jenseits stellt uns die kürzlich verstorbene Mary Alice ihre ehemaligen Nachbarinnen auf der Wisteria Lane vor und lässt uns hinter die Fassade ihres scheinbar perfekten Lebens blicken.
overview.en: ABC's Desperate Housewives offers a deliciously juicy glimpse into the lives of everyone's favorite housewives. On the surface, the ladies of Wisteria Lane appear to be the picture of suburban America. But underneath lay bigger mysteries - infidelity, deceit, blackmail, and even murder. And with not-so-honest husbands, complicated relationships, family drama and meddling neighbors adding to the turmoil, it's no wonder things aren't always as they seem.

NERVE-SHREDDING TERROR… THIS IS DANNY DYER AS YOU’VE NEVER SEEN HIM BEFORE. Prepare yourself for one of the year’s most terrifying films. An all-action adrenaline-fueled bloodbath that has been compared to Severance, Hostel and Saw, Deviation sees Danny Dyer returning to explosive form in what is being proclaimed as a career defining performance. Told over one horrifying night Deviation will take you on a white-knuckle journey into the mind of Frankie (Danny Dyer – The Business, Severance), a dangerous schizophrenic mental patient, as he escapes from Broadmoor Criminal Lunatic Asylum and embarks on a murderous rampage across central London. But when Frankie takes a hostage (Anna Walton) the deadly game of cat-and-mouse truly begins. WE DARE YOU TO WATCH THIS ALONE.

After a magazine scoop in Switzerland on the "12 Theses," everyone associated with it dies. As a series of mysterious and deadly events unfold, Captain Martin Jakobi and theology student Claire have to find out why and who.

title.de: Die Atombombe - Geschichte der mächtigsten Waffe der Welt

overview.en: This is the story of the most powerful and destructive device ever invented. With newly restored footage, go behind the scenes of the first atomic bomb, revealing how it was developed and how it changed the planet. Examine the choices society has made since 1945—and continues to make—to live with an invention that could destroy the planet.
Sent to live with her father in the Caribbean, a teen uses her newfound ability to communicate with dolphins to help save her dad's research facility.
Continuing the patriotic story of righteous warriors battling despotic leaders when a kung-fu expert is called in to reinforce the rebels during an 18th-century civil war in China.
Sharon Gless stars in her Emmy-nominated role as a divorced Beverly Hills lawyer who shocks her loved ones by becoming a Public Defender in L.A.
A comic story about the annual holiday gathering of a New England family, the Stones.
Peaceful Shaolin monks in Japanese-occupied China are forced to violently defend their temple when a group of ruthless ninjas plot to take it over.
A young couple moves to a quaint but strange town, only to suspect that their charming neighbors are part of an ancient witch coven.
Hoping to prove she's innocent of murder, a high school senior sets out to find the real killer before she becomes the next victim.

Arkus is reigned by Schiija. The Evil queen forces the inhabitants to give her their best work as gifts at the yearly gifts day. One day a former rival passes a hint on how to defeat the queen to the streetkids Jono and Saraja.
When a young girl moves from NYC to a mythical Irish village, she encounters an ancient spirit and attempts to save a herd of precious white horses.
A stubborn teenage girl finds herself transported into a world of fantasy and fairy tales while attending a school marionette show.
Paranormal activities of a terrifying and fatal kind overwhelms a team of ghost hunters searching for the haunted truth behind ghostly Jericho Manor.

title.en: How to Be a Good Wife

overview.en: A dutiful wife running a homemaker institute in 1968 France has her first fling with freedom when she’s suddenly made a widow facing financial ruin.

title.de: Die Reise Zum Mittelpunkt Der Erde
title.en: Journey to the Center of the Earth

overview.en: Enter Jules Verne's classic tale of a small band of explorers who cross from a beautiful underground cavern to the lost city of Atlantis.
When a band of assassins slaughters the family of Cho Osaki, he flees to America but soon discovers a ruthless drug trafficker intent on killing him.
The tale as old as time brings magic, romance, and music together as a young woman finds herself in the presence of an enchanted castle.
In coastal China, a mighty swordsman rallies a group of warriors and the local fishermen to fight off an invasion by Japanese pirates.

"The Kung-fu Instructor" is martial arts film director Sun Chung's loose homage to Akira Kurosawa's "Yojimbo" where unlike Toshiro Mifune's "Sanjuro" character being a snarling, bastard, drunk swordsman looking for a drink, popular actor Ti Lung's Huang Yang role, is an upright, righteous, weapon instructor looking to keep his limbs. Huang is a famous martial artist trapped into teaching kung-fu to the wrong clan while the opposing "good" clan tries to save him so he can instruct their members. Besides kung-fu comedienne Wang Yu starring in one of his few serious roles, Sun became the first Shaw Brothers’ director to use a Steadicam which gives the film's action and editing style a unique brand of tension and rhythm. The pole fights are also out of this world.
In 1908, an unappreciated secret agent for the Turkish sultan is persuaded to help a pair of English con artists steal a priceless Greek statue.

title.de: Die! - Ein Spiel auf Leben und Tod

overview.de: Charlotte wird bald 30, und die Menschen, die ihr am nächsten stehen, wollen nicht, dass sie das vergisst. Mit ihrem Job als Kellnerin, der so eintönig wie ihr Liebesleben ist, ist sie bereit für eine Veränderung. Eines Abends lernt sie Adam kennen, der genauso verloren scheint, wie sie selbst. Aus ihrer sofortigen Verbindung werden ein mitternächtlicher Drink und dann eine stürmische Romanze.
overview.en: Charlotte is about to turn 30, and the people closest to her won’t let her forget it. With a waitressing job as monotonous as her dating life, Charlotte is ready for a change. One night, she meets Adam, a handsome and soulful painter who seems just as lost as she feels. Their instant connection turns into a midnight drink and then a whirlwind romance of contemplation and tantalization.

5 children receive strange messages on their cell phones that lead them to a train that takes them to the "Digital World"; a strange world filled with bizarre creatures called "Digimon". These children have been sent there to stop an evil Digimon named Cherubimon from completely annihilating the planet of all its inhabitants.

Takato, Ruki, and Lee are children who have, by fate, received real Digimon, unlike the imaginary ones in the card game they play. Each of the children, or "Digimon Tamers," have their different views on how Digimon should be treated. But when other Digimon begin to appear around Japan, they must put aside their differences to fend off the digital intruders.

A small-town marshal (Guy Pearce) who hasn’t carried a gun since he left the Texas Rangers, must pick up his gun again to do battle with a gang of outlaw bikers who have invaded the town to pull off a brazen and violent heist.
This western follows the life of the infamous Doc Holliday — a gunslinger, gambler, and dentist — leading up to the historic O.K. Corral shootout.

Elizabeth is a charming anchorwoman who seeks advice from her dog's therapist. Tara is a spunky barista who dreams of a life beyond the coffee shop. Daisy is a dog walker who's enamored with a client. Garrett pines for a woman while trying to keep his adopt-a-dog business afloat. The beloved canines in their lives soon start to influence their careers, friendships and romantic relationships in funny and unexpected ways.

overview.de: Als ein treuer Polizeihund und sein Polizistenherrchen bei einem Einsatz verletzt werden, werden sie zusammen durch eine verrückte, aber lebensrettende Operation zu Dog Man. Dog Man hat geschworen, zu schützen und zu dienen - und zu apportieren, Sitz zu machen und sich zu rollen. Während Dog Man sich bemüht seinen Boss zu beeindrucken, muss er die bösen Pläne des Schurkenkaters Petey vereiteln.
overview.en: While learning to embrace his new identity, Dog Man must stop feline supervillain Petey the Cat from cloning himself and going on a crime spree.
Count Dracula and his wife capture beautiful young women and chain them in their dungeon, to be used when they need to satisfy their thirst for blood.
A poet-turned-alcoholic tries to find stability by returning to his family home, where his nephew, who longs to sail away, redirects his course.
A military pilot-turned-helicopter traffic reporter becomes a one-man rescue operation after getting a bird's-eye view of a bank heist and kidnapping.

title.de: Easy Money III - Lass sie bluten

overview.en: Living in exile and more determined than ever to find out what happened to his missing sister, JW is led into Stockholm’s world of organized crime.

overview.de: Ana de Armas spielt als eiskalte Baronesse auf einer der Galapagos-Inseln die Aussteiger Daniel Brühl und Jude Law gegeneinander aus. Thriller von Oscargewinner Ron Howard.
overview.en: Eden is a provocative and surprising survival thriller about the lengths we will go to in pursuit of happiness. Based on two wildly different takes on the same true story, Eden explores one of the longest-standing and most compelling unsolved human mysteries ever, where eight people went to a remote island in the Galapagos and less than half survived.

The Public is about downtown Cincinnati librarians Stuart Goodson (Emilio Estevez) and Myra (Jena Malone) who see their regular winter day shaken up when homeless patrons decide to take shelter in their library for the night. What starts as a peaceful sit-in quickly escalates into a face-off with the police and the media.
An Australian pastor and his wife become media prey in 1980 after she claims that a dingo has stolen their baby.

Based on Ingmar Bergman's Smiles of a Summer's Night and Jean Renoir's Rules of the Game, the story revolves around a weekend party at the home of Andrew Hobbs, a Wall Street broker and eccentric inventor, and his wife Adrian. The guests of honor are Ariel and Leopold, Andrew's cousin and a famed academic. Over the course of the weekend, they are joined by a third couple, a lady-killer doctor and his date, a ditzy nurse. By the end of the weekend, sexual partners are changed.

A group of lovable half-animal, half-human girls who share a special bond with their cuddly animal besties -- The Enchantimals live in a magical world where fun and adventure are around every corner and friendship makes anything possible!  Together, hand in paw, they explore the whimsical worlds in Tales from Everwilde and discover even when things get a bit wild, caring is everything.

This documentary explores the life of Duncan Edwards, a football prodigy and key member of Manchester United's "Busby Babes." His career was tragically cut short in the 1958 Munich air disaster, leaving a lasting legacy that continues to inspire today.
Based on the life of the famous motorcycle daredevil, Bobby Knievel’s marketing stunt for his auto shop turns him into an international superstar.

Somebody built a goddamn school gym directly over the stolen cash his girlfriend buried for him. And now, ex-con Zeki Müller has no choice but to pass himself off as a substitute teacher at Goethe Comprehensive School, thus providing the German educational system with one more problem, i.e. the craziest teacher of all time.
A teacher accompanies a class trip to Thailand to recover some diamonds accidentally sent there.

title.de: Faith of Angels: Der Glaube an Engel

overview.en: After John Skinner (John Michael Finley) is prompted to "help them see," he learns 10-year-old Joshua Dennis (Michael Bradford) is missing in an abandoned mine.  Sheriff Stan Proctor (Cameron Arnett) sends rescue crews deep into mine, but after five days, hope begins to fade.  A final push results in an unexpected twist of faith, and a miracle that few believed possible.
Faith, una mujer divorciada, participa en un concurso de baile para salvar su estudio de danza, donde conoce a Jimmy y redescubre su fe y sus sueños.

In the wake of an alien attack that has crippled most of the world, shock has turned to resolve as the survivors gather to fight back. Leading the charge is Boston history professor Tom Mason, whose wife was killed in the attack, and one of his three sons is among a group of captive teens. Desperate to rescue his son, Tom joins forces with the 2nd Massachusetts, a makeshift regiment assigned to protect the survivors. As second in command to Weaver, Tom uses his knowledge of military history to gain intelligence about the aliens and form a plan of attack. But the plan keeps changing and more questions surface as the survivors discover what they're really up against: a highly intelligent, heavily armed alien force whose purpose on Earth is the biggest mystery of all.
When a tainted drug shipment hits the streets of L.A., a witty narcotics cop goes undercover to investigate in this fast-paced romantic comedy.

title.de: Felony - Ein Moment kann alles verändern

overview.en: After a tragic accident leaves a child in critical condition, an Australian cop sees his world unravelling as his team seeks to find the truth.

It is the summer of 1957 and ex-racer Enzo Ferrari is in crisis, facing bankruptcy and a volatile marriage. Meanwhile, his drivers’ passions push them to the edge as they launch into the treacherous race across Italy, the Mille Miglia.
Two adventurers follow a map to a lost gold mine, but the trail is full of killer crocodiles, shocking twists, and unpredictable turns.
An aspiring actress who has gained a massive following on social media finds herself trapped in her new boss’ twisted revenge fantasy.
A champ kickboxer promises his family he’s done in the cage, only to have to win a series of savage MMA matches to save his brother from a crime boss.

An all-out-action cyber thriller starring action legend Bruce Willis, Jesse Metcalfe (Escape Plan II) and Chad Michael Murray (One Tree Hill). Robert is a retired CIA agent living at a secret resort. When his estranged son visits, he is followed by Robert's old nemesis, Balzary. Under attack, they retreat to a high-tech bunker. But is it powerful enough to match Balzary's bloodthirsty revenge?
Four idiotic terrorists push their fuzzy dreams of jihad to the breaking point, as their beliefs and methods clash, in this far-out British farce.
Matan and three fellow Israeli soldiers are sent on a mission to patrol a remote base where a series of unexplained phenomena begin to terrorize them.
A young American couple are expecting their first child, but wish to take a dream trip to Europe first and book private accommodations through an Internet portal.

On Halloween, a group of medical students steal the corpse a serial killer from a morgue and raise him from the dead, inadvertently putting themselves and a group of young neighborhood children in danger.
A steamy and passionate love affair between a local bar owner and a young woman soon falls into the conflicts of lust, love, and jealousy.

title.en: The Adventures of the Galaxy Rangers

overview.en: En la Francia de 1943, dos jóvenes alsacianas son enviadas por los nazis a un campo de trabajo para realizar una labor sumamente peligrosa.
Waking up next to another woman after his wild bachelor party with no memory of the night before, a distressed man tries to keep his fiancee.

"I'm not saving the world. I just kill goblins." Rumor has it that, in a certain guild in the middle of nowhere, there is an extraordinary man who has climbed all the way to the Silver rank just by killing goblins. At the same guild, a priestess who's just become a new adventurer has formed her first party... and the man who ends up rescuing that party when they get into trouble is none ...

overview.de: Gewinner von 3 Oscars®, inklusive der Auszeichnung als Bester Film! Tony Lip, ein Italo-Amerikaner aus der Bronx, der sein Geld hauptberuflich als Türsteher verdient, wird von dem kultivierten und begnadeten, afroamerikanischen Pianisten Dr. Don Shirley als Fahrer engagiert. Die beiden Männer, die gegensätzlicher nicht sein könnten, begeben sich 1962 auf eine Konzert-Tournee durch die Südstaaten. Doch tief im Süden der USA weht ein anderer Wind – und so müssen Tony und Dr. Shirley ihre Reise in Zeiten der Rassentrennung nach dem sogenannten „Green Book“ planen, einem Reiseführer für schwarze Autofahrer, der die wenigen Unterkünfte und Restaurants auflistet, die auch schwarze Gäste bedienen.
overview.en: When a refined pianist hires a street-smart driver to navigate a concert tour of the segregated South, a friendship forms amid the backdrop of racism.
Sam is an alcoholic grieving over his father's death. When he meets the seductive Anna at a party, he immediately falls under her spell but begins to suspect that she's an actual vampire.
This sparklingly witty, London-set romance is based on the inspiring true story of a man's against-all-odds fight to save his home.

Meet the Dholakias, a family of four generations living under one roof, as they navigate the ups and downs of their lives. While they appear to be picture perfect, they are endearingly, heartbreakingly human, each with their unique quirks and quibbles. Follow their journey as they try their best to navigate through all the things life throws at them.

title.de: Heart of Midnight - Im Herzen der Nacht

overview.en: While recovering from a mental breakdown, Carol inherits a seedy nightclub and her sanity is put to the test as she discovers its dark secrets.
As the names of Chang Cheh and Liu Chia-liang became legendary, all-too-often the name of their equally valued collaborator, Tang Chia, is omitted.
When the faithful canine companion to the Duke of Dingwall, Hubert, inherits the Duke's estate, he teams up with the Butler's niece to fend off some greedy family members.
Un hombre en un viaje a Rusia es confundido con un ladrón de joyas y arrojado a un mundo de gánsteres, donde su única salida es una mujer rusa.
A Cajun beauty lures male intruders into a swamp where women have a field day with them.
Duncan MacLeod is Immortal and must live in modern society, concealing his true nature while fighting other Immortals and a secret society.
A woman who has lost everything returns to her remote childhood home in New Mexico, only to discover that two psychotic squatters have moved in.
When a young woman’s ambitions, dreams, and hopes misalign, her pursuit of stardom spirals into a series of unpredictable, life-altering consequences.

overview.de: Joe Bowers arbeitet als Bibliothekar bei der Army und ist nicht unbedingt der intelligenteste Zeitgenosse. Ein optimales Versuchskaninchen also für das streng geheime Projekt des Pentagons: Ein Experiment, bei dem Menschen in einen Winterschlaf versetzt werden, um sie zu einem späteren Zeitpunkt wieder zum Leben zu erwecken. Das auf ein Jahr angesetzte Projekt gerät in Vergessenheit und Joe Bowers und die ihm damals als Partnerin zugeteilte Prostituierte Rita erwachen im Jahre 2505. In Mitten einer inzwischen total verdummten Menschheit und von Blödheit regierten Welt sind die beiden allen anderen mit ihrer Intelligenz haushoch überlegen. Joe nutzt seine Chance und kandidiert bei den Präsidentschaftswahlen in Amerika.
overview.en: An average guy wakes up in the year 2505 and discovers he's now the smartest man on Earth.

title.de: Ilana Glazer: The Planet Is Burning
title.en: Ilana Glazer: The Planet Is Burning

overview.en: “Broad City” star Ilana Glazer steps up in her first standup comedy set, done in her own raucous style as she takes on Nazis, diva cups, and stoners.
With the help of friends, food, and passion, Karin refuses to accept that life has an expiration date and decides to take a second chance at living.

overview.de: Christopher Nolan dreht mit internationaler Besetzung SiFi-Actionthriller "Inception", originäre Geschichte, die die Zuschauer um ganze Erde & in intime & unendliche Welt der Träume führt.
overview.en: Leonardo DiCaprio plays a thief who steals corporate secrets from sleeping minds. Now he must be the first to pull off the reverse: planting an idea in exchange for his freedom.
An ex-con, whose path was governed by a twist of fate, becomes a detective and is hired to investigate the crime boss who used to be his best friend.
While searching for her sister who disappeared on route to a concert, Sarah unwittingly finds answers after stopping for the night at a vacant hotel.
An astrophysicist, who questions the nature of human existence, lands in a coma and finds terrifying answers, while suspended between life and death.

title.de: Jane Austen und das Chaos in meinem Leben

overview.en: Agathe (Camille Rutherford, Anatomy of a Fall) seems to be living the romantic dream. Working in the iconic Parisian bookshop "Shakespeare & Co", she shares an undeniable chemistry with her best friend/co-worker Félix (Pablo Pauly). However, underneath the rosy facade, Agathe is a struggling romance author stuck living with her sister and battling a severe case of writer's block.

title.de: Jane Austen: Die Abtei von Northanger

overview.en: When Catherine Morland is invited to stay at Northanger Abbey, she finds evidence of a sinister family secret. Based on Jane Austen's homage to Gothic romance.
A man from a struggling family in inner-city Houston finds love and hope with a waitress dreamer whose past secrets will come to threaten his future.

At the end of WWII, Jimmy Picard, a Native American Blackfoot who fought in France, suffers from unexplainable symptoms and is admitted to a military hospital. When doctors suspect schizophrenia, an eccentric psychoanalyst takes up the case and starts a conversation with the veteran.
A teen boy in colonial Maine protects the family home against peril, with the help of a young Indian, when his father leaves to bring the family home.
A retired fighter returns to the ring after his younger brother is killed by an old rival in an underground Terminal Combat tournament.

The city of Chicago is plagued by Gang Violence on both sides of the city in this modern retelling of the classic Romeo and Juliet story. In the midst of their chaos, two young lovers must navigate their dangerous circumstances to escape their affiliations and discover true love.
While vacationing in a remote cabin, a group of friends is attacked by deadly insects and must find a way to destroy them before it’s too late.
In this action-packed thriller; an army commando takes on knife-wielding thieves on a New Delhi-bound train in a death-defying kill-spree to save the innocent passengers.
In search of a new attraction for his show, a circus owner leads an expedition into the African jungle to find and capture a rumored giant gorilla.
Krishna enjoys married life with Priya until he crosses paths with Kaal, an evil genius.

After coming out to his parents, Lukas is kicked out of his home over night. Soon after he finds himself in a big city full of opportunities and interesting people. One of them is the 17-year-old Leopold, who's growing relationship with Lukas is shortly after put to the test. Meanwhile their new friends Jan and Noah have problems of their own: Jan is struggling with his boyfriend's fetish fantasy.
A detective investigating missing persons cases finds clues hidden at the bottom of a lake linked to racial injustice in Reconstruction Era-Georgia.
A troubled young woman living on the margins suddenly finds herself on death row for the murder of an elderly widow she didn't commit.

overview.de: Wuchtiges Fernost-Epos mit starker Action und opulenten Bildern: Tom Cruise kämpft als desillusionierter US-Captain an der Seite unbeugsamer Samurai gegen die Truppen des japanischen Kaisers. - 1876: Der gebrochene US-Kriegsheld Nathan Algren (Tom Cruise) soll der japanischen Armee helfen, den Samurai-Rebellen Katsumoto (Ken Watanabe) zu unterwerfen. Nach einer fatalen Niederlage gerät Algren in die Gewalt seiner Feinde. Fasziniert von deren traditionellem Ehrenkodex findet er seine Selbstachtung wieder und schließt sich den Samurai an.
overview.en: In the 1870s, a Westerner is caught in the middle of a battle between the samurai and the emperor.

Was a motorcycle crash an accident or attempt at assassination by the British Secret Service? "Lawrence: After Arabia" tells the story of the last years of the life of the 20th century hero, T.E. Lawrence - Lawrence of Arabia.
Rival journalists competing for the same lucrative promotion get stuck together in snowy Alaska after their plane is forced to make an emergency landing.

When Chen decides to enroll in dance lessons, he upsets his Israeli father but pleases his Russian mother. Amid mounting tensions at home, Chen finds joy in his lessons and in the true source of his interest in the sport: his crush and classmate, Natalie.
A divorced father of two is dedicated to his kids, his job as an architect, and his dog, Lucky—who tends to be a bit overprotective.
The last big score for a master art thief trying to escape the life only pulls him in deeper when he meets an actress with her own chaotic past.

overview.de: Wahnsinn in der Wüste: Im Reboot der legendären Action-Reihe stürzen sich Tom Hardy und Rebellin Charlize Theron in eine furiose Vollgas-Schlacht gegen einen Warlord. Sechs Oscars!
overview.en: From director George Miller comes the fourth adventure in the Mad Max film series.

title.de: Magisches Island - Leben auf der größten Vulkaninsel der Welt
title.en: Magical Iceland: Living on the World's Largest Volcanic Island

overview.en: Teenage Maggie deals with growing up, her first love, a quirky family, and moving to a new town - all while discovering she has synesthesia: a condition that causes her to see sounds, hear colors, and more.

overview.de: Eine Hochzeit, die man nie vergisst! Sophie (Amanda Seyfried) wünscht sich nichts sehnlicher, als von ihrem leiblichen Vater zum Altar geführt zu werden. Dafür wäre es gut zu wissen, wer er ist. Doch ihre Mutter Donna (Meryl Streep) hat dieses Geheimnis nie gelüftet.
overview.en: A bride secretly invites three men from her mother's (Meryl Streep) past to come to the wedding.
The lone Apache, Massai, valiantly fights a one-man war against the U.S. Army in his attempt to remain free at any cost.
A quirky 15-year-old girl in the 1960s comes to terms with her recent move to a new small town, her budding sexuality, and her promiscuous mother.

title.de: Mein Freund Smitty - Ein tierisches Abenteuer

overview.en: While spending the summer at his grandfather's farm, a boy learns about the importance of friendship, family and responsibility with the help of a lovable rescue dog.

title.de: Mermaid Magic – Die magische Welt der Meerjungfrauen

overview.en: To save her kingdom, a determined young mermaid princess and her friends must join forces with the creatures that scare them the most — humans.
This mini-series follows Jane Austen as she nears her 40th birthday and lifts the lid on the secrets of the love life of the celebrated novelist.

title.de: Mississippi Speed Record: An Epic Adventure
title.en: Mississippi Speed Record: An Epic Adventure

title.de: Mit Liebe zum Mord - Das Katz-und-Maus-Spiel
title.en: Aurora Teagarden Mysteries: A Game of Cat and Mouse

overview.en: A taunting clue left for Aurora at a meeting begins a cat-and-mouse game between her and a mysterious criminal who commits increasingly serious crimes that leave the town rattled. Candace Cameron Bure, Niall Matter, Marilu Henner.
An undercover cop posing as an inmate in a dangerously corrupt prison uncovers the ghoulish secret behind a string of ritualistic cell block murders.
Sing Monster in the Style of "Imagine Dragons". Stingray Karaoke Pop, 2013, English, Key Fm.

The corpse of a young man appears in a forest on the island of La Gomera. The case closes with the accusation to a local politician who is exonerated in the later judgment. Three years later, Sergeant Bevilaqua and his assistant, Corporal Chamorro, are sent to the island to revive the investigation. Corporal Anglada accompanies them, the last one who saw the young man alive.
After an attorney investigates a malpractice case against her physician husband and learns he had an affair with a nurse, she suspects them of murder.
In the midst of World War II, an RAF pilot plans to heroically descend on France, where prisoners are held and a Nazi rocket is being developed.

title.de: My Letter to the World: A Journey Through the Life of Emily Dickinson
title.en: My Letter to the World: A Journey Through the Life of Emily Dickinson

overview.en: Narrated by Cynthia Nixon, this documentary is an in-depth exploration of the life and work of the great American poet, Emily Dickinson.

title.de: Nang Nak - Return from the Dead

overview.en: A suspended cop is given one more chance when a fellow officer is found murdered.
During a treacherous train ride across the snowy western frontier, an agent posing as a fugitive is on a mission to catch a dangerous gang of outlaws.

Some would say Aurore lives a boring life. But when you are a 13 year-old girl, and just like her have an uncompromising way of looking at boys, school, family or friends, life takes on the appearance of a merry psychodrama. Especially with a new French teacher, the threat of being sent to boarding school, repeatedly falling in love and the crazy idea of going on stage with a band...
When the life of a martial arts master is shattered by his wife’s brutal murder, he enlists an old friend to sharpen his skills and seek revenge.

overview.de: Robert Eggers' NOSFERATU - DER UNTOTE ist eine Gothic-Geschichte über die Besessenheit einer jungen Frau und einen angsteinflößenden Vampir, der sie betört und für unsagbares Grauen sorgt.
overview.en: A gothic tale of obsession between a haunted young woman and the terrifying vampire infatuated with her, causing untold horror in its wake. (2024)(132 mins)

Based on a novel "A Distant Father" by Antonio Skármeta, author of from "Il Postino," The Movie of My Life takes place in 1963 Brazil. The son of an French man and a Brazilian woman, Tony is captivated by cinema and poetry. After graduating from college he returns to his hometown to find out that his father has left for good. Tony turns to his father's friends, searching for information about his lost father. He becomes a school teacher and a defacto father figure to the school children. As he provides them with something he has lacked, he uncovers a lead on his own father's whereabouts and his reasons for leaving.
An escaped convict hiding on a widow’s farm is forced to act when a ruthless developer threatens her land, turning him into an unlikely protector.

title.de: Ohne jede Gnade - Im Reich der Camorra
One Year to Live, Buy a Man
title.en: One Year to Live, Buy a Man

overview.en: In the search for the vicious, supernatural Pentagram Killer, a desperate detective tries to track down the spirit, which can possess other’s bodies.
After helping a woman seemingly in need, a man awakens the next day with his kidney missing and his heart set on revenge.

title.de: Prison Escape - Der Tunnel der Knochen

overview.en: Durante su espectacular escape de la prisión, basado en un hecho real, siete presos hacen un macabro descubrimiento en el tunel de su libertad.
A troubled teen uses her newfound friendship with two popular cheerleaders to become the school’s “Most Inspirational” student by any means necessary.
DI Bong (Donnie Yen) discovers his former protégé gone rogue is behind a brutal crime. A score needs to be settled once and for all.

Rocket Perelman is a strange name for a commune in the middle of nowhere in Brandenburg. But the inhabitants of the Rocket are also a little unusual. The ten of them are attempting to live together as freely, independently and, most importantly, as happily as they can.

An all-star comedy cast brings laughs from start to finish when a casino tycoon gives six money-crazed contestants the chance to win $2 million in a race from Las Vegas to New Mexico. Who will win this dash for the cash is anybody's guess, but one thing is for sure - it's going to be a hilarious ride.

title.de: Return of the Living Dead: Rave to the Grave
title.en: Return of the Living Dead: Rave to the Grave

overview.en: A group of students are turned to zombies after taking a strange drug at a party.

title.de: Riddle - Jede Stadt hat ihr tödliches Geheimnis

overview.en: A C.I.A. Agent tries to infiltrate Soviet intelligence to stop a murderous diabolical plot.
When a man finds out his mother is dying and tries to hitchhike his way to the hospital, he is picked up by a stranger with a deadly secret.

title.de: Rin Tin Tin - Ein Held auf Pfoten

overview.en: During World War I, an American pilot befriends a stray German Shepherd, soon to become the most famous animal star in Hollywood history.
A 17-year-old embarks on a quest to find her missing father, navigating life while pursuing her dream of becoming a pro hockey player.
The sole survivor of a 17th-century shipwreck washes ashore on a deserted island where he’s forced to carve out a new life with his bare hands.
Have a holly jolly Christmas with the most famous reindeer of all in the original holiday special, Rudolph the Red-Nosed Reindeer!
Dave Hart integrates into Ashbourne to experience its traditional, wild football game firsthand.

In 1959 Leopoldville, as political tensions rise, a young photographer's life is upended when the woman he loves is found dead. Accused of her death, he escapes prison to uncover a devastating betrayal that lies hidden within the legendary Rumba Royale.

Once a powerful wrestling champion, a man suffers an injury that ends his career. He starts gambling and drinking while taking care of his son. He tells his son that his mother died, but later the son discovers she is alive. This leads to a turbulent journey of healing and making things right.

overview.de: Die Entführung einer seiner Schülerinnen weckt bei Wrestling-Coach Harry Summer schmerzhafte Erinnerungen an seine damals verschleppte und ermordete Tochter. Entgegen der Warnung der Polizei nimmt er die Suche nach der verschleppten Catia in die eigene Hand und stößt dabei auf einen brutalen Menschenhändlerring.
overview.en: After a student is kidnapped, a high school wrestling coach takes matters into his own hands, hunting down the men behind a human trafficking ring.

A reporter attempting to write a story about the grueling 3000 kilometer race across Africa must rely on the help of an ex-stuntman to thwart the efforts of a ruthless Count who will stop at nothing to eliminate his competition.
When 66 deposit boxes are looted in a Brussels bank heist, the trail leads to Salamander, a secret organization threatening to topple Belgium.

overview.de: Vor zwanzig Jahren wurde der Held von Granite City, Samaritan, nach einem Kampf mit seinem Rivalen Nemesis für tot erklärt. Die meisten denken, dass er im Feuer umgekommen ist, aber ein kleiner Junge glaubt fest daran, dass Samaritan noch lebt!
overview.en: A young boy embarks on a journey to find out if the mythic hero who disappeared from his neighborhood two decades ago still lives.

title.de: Samson - Der Auserwählte, Der Verratene, Der Triumphator

overview.en: A child born with supernatural strength in 1200 BC grows up to lead his oppressed tribe with great valor against the mighty empire of his day.

Elisa and Anthea are 15-year-old girls whose mismatched friendship gives them support and orientation during a difficult phase in their lives. To susatian their bond, they devise a sinister game that takes on destructive dynamics. After Elisa suffers a breakdown, which is mercilessly filmed by her classmates on their cell phones, the two simply turn the cameras around in revenge.
Several friends break into a morgue and pretend to summon spirits from the dead, only to actually summon a deadly demon that possesses one of them.

title.de: Sex Is Zero - American Pie war gestern...

overview.en: Un muchacho de 13 años atravesará el mundo luchando contra espíritus malignos en la gran batalla para convertirse en el próximo rey chamán.

title.de: Shaolin - Die Rache mit der Todeshand

overview.en: Vince and Freddy hit on the idea of a lifetime: shark-proof wetsuits! Determined to strike it rich, they face car chases, shoot-outs, and mob mayhem!

When massive volcanic storms begin to spew from the Earth, geophysicist Kate Ferris tries to convince the Department of Defense that this is no natural phenomenon. They’re the result of a seismic super weapon and the shockwaves it sends out will destroy major cities across the globe, killing millions.

title.de: Si Buta dari Gua Hantu: Neraka Perut Bumi
title.en: The Blind Man from Ghost Cave: Blind Warrior

overview.en: A wandering warrior and his monkey companion put an end to the reign of a psychopathic and brutal despot after entering a village under his thumb.

overview.de: Bombastische Action, null Dialoge: Action-Meister John Woo schickt Joel Kinnaman auf einen gnadenlosen Rachefeldzug gegen die Killer seines kleinen Sohnes.
overview.en: From legendary director John Woo and the producer of John Wick comes this visceral revenge tale of a tormented father seeking vengeance after his son dies in a gang’s crossfire.

overview.de: Illumination Entertainments („Pets“) neuester Animationshit Sing ist eine rasante Komödie über die uns im tiefsten Inneren berührende Musik und ihre Interpretation. Um sein vor dem Ruin stehendes Theater zu retten, veranstaltet der unbeirrbar optimistische Koala Buster Moon den ultimativen Gesangswettbewerb für neue Talente.
overview.en: When a dapper koala puts on a singing competition to save his once-grand theater, animals from across the city gather to step into the spotlight.

overview.de: Der ewig optimistische Koala Buster Moon und seine All-Stars träumen von der Show ihres Lebens in der glamourösen Glitzer- Metropole Redshore City. Es gibt nur ein Problem: Sie müssen Rocklegende Clay Calloway davon überzeugen, für diese Show auf die Bühne zurückzukehren.
overview.en: All your favorite singing and dancing all-stars from Illumination's Sing return in the feel-good event of the year. The ever-optimistic koala, Buster Moon, and his cast have big dreams of staging their most dazzling show yet in the glittering entertainment capital of the world, Redshore City.

Heart warming and hilarious, Guardian of the Highlands features an all-star cast including Academy Award® winner Sir Sean Connery in his first ever animated voice-over role as Sir Billi, the Guardian of the Highlands.
A preteen 19th-century lass of noble birth charms everyone she meets and, when she comes of age, the Hapsburg emperor pursues her to fascinating ends.
A slumber party turns into a bloodbath when a psychopath wielding a power-drill disrupts the fun. Slumber Party Massacre is a reimagining of Roger Corman's 1982 cult classic.
Arriving at his late grandfather’s cabin, a young professional discovers a series of puzzles that lead him and his friends to a dangerous secret.

title.de: Son de mar – Nicht ohne dich

overview.en: Ulises llega a una ciudad como maestro. Conoce a Martina, se casan y tienen un hijo, y un día mientras él está pescando desaparece sin dejar rastro.
A man with Down syndrome leads a group of social outcasts in a rebellion to overthrow the evil president of a dystopian future America.

title.de: Spider Web - Once Upon A time in Seoul

overview.en: To reshoot the ending of his film, a movie director wrestles with interference from censorship authorities and disgruntled cast and crew members.
The unbelievable true story of how music producer Neil Bogart and Casablanca Records launched the music that became the soundtrack of a generation.

title.de: Steel Sharks - Überleben ist ihr Ziel

overview.en: In this undersea thriller, a United States chemist is captured by terrorists. But a rescue attempt by an elite group of Navy Seals goes wrong when they are captured. Now they must wage a silent war beneath the waves.

title.en: The Taking of Pelham One Two Three

overview.en: On a New York subway train, hijackers threaten to kill the strangers aboard if they don't get their million dollar ransom in an hour.

overview.de: Eine geheime Regierungsagentur rekrutiert Superbösewichte, um gefährliche Einsätze im Austausch gegen eine Begnadigung durchzuführen.
overview.en: U.S. intelligence officer Amanda Waller has assembled a team of the world's most dangerous, incarcerated super villains, provides them with the most powerful arsenal at the government's disposal and sends them off on a mission to defeat an enigmatic, powerful entity. But once they realize they weren't picked to succeed but chosen for their patent culpability when they inevitably fail, will the Suicide Squad resolve to die trying or decide it's every man for himself?

overview.de: Ein Junge mit einer Hirnstörung inspiriert privilegierte Supersportwagenbesitzer durch Freundlichkeit und Mitgefühl zu einer Wandlung, unterstützt durch ein Traumtreffen mit John Cena von der WWE.
overview.en: Boy with brain disorder inspires privileged supercar owners to transform through kindness and compassion, aided by a dream meeting with WWE's John Cena.
A distress call to a rescue and recovery ship 3432 light years away puts the crew in the gravitational pull of a giant star about to go supernova.
In a town of high tensions, two rival cattlemen must set aside their differences to save the community from a nasty group of outlaws who just rode in.
When skilled sniper Charlie Snow returns home to Los Angeles, he must deal with the repercussions of war and revenge to protect his family.

Rejected by his peers, Professor Herbert, visionary and intrepid, embarks on a daring expedition to the unexplored confines of Antarctica. At the heart of the ice, enigmatic traces of a forgotten civilization emerge.

title.de: The Butcher, the Chef and the Swordsman
title.en: The Butcher, the Chef, and the Swordsman

overview.en: The Butcher, The Chef and the Swordsman follows the journey of a mystical blade as it passes through the hands of three ambitious men. As the interwoven story unfolds, they find that the blade possesses the power to dramatically.

Arisugawa Tetsuko has just moved to a new house with her recently divorced mother. She becomes a transfer student at a school where a strange rumor lingers among the students. When she starts to investigate into it, she ends meeting Hana Arai, her young strange neighbor who rarely leaves the house.

A high school junior transfers to a new school when her mom enters rehab, quickly clashing with the resident mean girl. Her aunt and uncle offer to throw a sweet sixteen to help her adjust, but the jealous queen bee plots to ruin it, even resorting to murder. The teen's mom must redeem herself to save the party and, more importantly, her relationship with her daughter.
Host Brendan Moar dives into the process of what it takes to bring down some of the biggest structures from around the world.
Over an elaborate meal at a fancy restaurant, two sets of parents decide what to do to protect their teenage sons, who committed a shocking crime.

overview.de: Sie haben die aufregendsten und adrenalinreichsten Martial-Arts Filme aller Zeiten abgeliefert. Nun treten Jackie Chan und Jet Li erstmals gemeinsam auf, um das größte Epos aller Zeiten zu entfesseln - "Forbidden Kingdom". Als altertümliche chinesische Krieger müssen sie einen Kung-Fu Fanatiker aus dem 21. Jahrhundert trainieren, der in das antike China gerufen wurde, um einen seit Jahrhunderten andauernden Kampf zu beenden und den legendären Monkey King zu befreien ... Das Warten hat ein Ende: Sei bereit für das größte Fantasy-Abenteuer aller Zeiten!
overview.en: A mystical staff sends an American teen to China, where he joins martial artists on a quest to free the imprisoned Monkey King.

title.de: The Golden Throne - Der neue Khan

overview.en: In the 15th century, Genghis Khan’s descendants forge the Kazakh Khanate in Eurasia, battling enemies to defend their long-promised land.
Brutal conflict brews to a violent pitch in this thriller about criminal clans and syndicates of South East London that involves two generations.

title.de: The Last Note - Sinfonie des Lebens

overview.en: A famous pianist suddenly afflicted with severe stage fright confronts old wounds, with the aid of a free-spirited critic with a unique take on life.
In 1997, four campers went missing during the infamous Phoenix Lights incident and their bodies were never found. This is their last, known footage.  The campers' whereabouts are still unknown.

Three college students on a road trip across the Southwest experience a detour: the tracking of a computer genius who has already hacked into MIT and exposed security faults. The trio find themselves drawn to an eerily isolated area. Suddenly everything goes dark. When one of the students, Nic (Brenton Thwaites), regains consciousness, he is in a waking nightmare…

A group of wounded, injured, and sick military veterans from around the world embark on an expedition to conquer a 4000+ meter peak and the Great Sand Dunes in Colorado. This journey is both a physical and mental challenge, as nature heals their scars. Each step towards the summit represents overcoming personal battles and reaching the peaks of their inner struggles.
Set during the Taiping Rebellion of the 1860s, a general survives a massacre of his soldiers and joins a band of bandits to protect innocents.
A satirical comedy set in 1932, about two clueless teenage socialite heiresses with zero survival skills who find themselves lost in the wilderness with a price on their heads.
The sheriff of a small mountain town and his lackluster team of officers must solve a series of brutal murders occurring during the full moon.

Yoga teacher Ann cannot escape her manic family, miserable dating life, and inability to say no, leaving her constantly trying to fix everyone else's problems. But can she finally put herself first when a new love walks into her life?
Riley Ann is a failed actress-turned-camgirl living in Hollywood who captures the heart of an obsessive fan who’s determined to have her in real life.
Searching for his missing sister, a reclusive fisherman joins forces with a detective probing an alarming string of murders in the Pacific Northwest.

title.de: Tiger Team - Der Berg der 1000 Drachen
title.en: Tiger Team: The Mountain of 1000 Dragons

title.de: Tim und Struppi und das Geheimnis um das goldene Vlies
title.en: Tintin and the Mystery of the Golden Fleece

overview.en: In Tintin's first-ever live-action adaptation Captain Haddock sets sail to Istanbul, accompanied by our cow-licked hero and his cohorts. There they collect a strange bounty from the late Captain Paparanic: a rusty old ship called the Golden Fleece. But the real treasure lies in a chest under the sea, as they discover a map with an "X" on it-marking the spot of Paparanic's gold.

title.en: The Legend of Tim Tyler: The Boy Who Lost His Laugh

overview.en: On the Russian Front in the harsh winter of 1943, a cop-turned-soldier tries to track down the killer behind a series of brutal murders.
Maverick cop, Jake Wilder, is convinced his career is in jeopardy when he meets his new partner: a mischievous, high-I.Q. canine named Reno.

title.de: Trimurti - Der ewige Kreis der Liebe

overview.en: Trimurti Is A Hindi Action Movie, Directed By Mukul S. Anand And Produced By Subhash Ghai, Starring Anil Kapoor, Shah Rukh Khan, Jackie Shroff, Anjali Jathar And Priya Tendulkar In The Lead Roles. After Being Falsely Accused And Imprisoned, Satyadevi Hopes That Her Three Sons Will Free Her And Get Revenge On Her Accuser. However, She Learns That They Lead Separate Lives And Hate Each Other.
In the midst of World War II, a resolute sub commander must contend with a tough executive officer to take revenge on an infamous Japanese destroyer.
This thrilling, hour-long feature is a compilation of four different shorts: The Ticket, The Jealous Woman, The Thief, and Enough.

Maria (Kim Basinger) is a successful business executive, struggling to fulfill her greatest wish of all: to bring a child into the world. After suffering yet another miscarriage, a doctor informs Maria that she's too old to carry a child and her whole world comes crashing down. Devastated and unable to accept her fate, Maria sets out on a desperate and perilous quest to realize her dream of motherhood.



Director Anders Morgenthaler challenges the audience’s perceptions of vulnerability, power and emotional disturbance by exploring the soul of a very damaged character who still may manage to achieve her dreams.
