Uncompromising to the highest degree, he populates the world with losers, con-men and violent criminals whose nihilism correlates perfectly with the dead-eyed quest of our lead.
An aging and drug-addled ballplayer gets his last shot at the pros but he’ll have to turn his back on a trafficked underage girl to make the team.
An anthology of films focused on the concept of how people move forward despite adversity, from the importance of new beginnings to second chances at the end of dark tunnels.

Chosen as humanity’s representative in a duel against invading aliens, the womanizing Ataru faces off against the alien princess Lum — and the conflict follows him home when Lum invades both planet Earth AND the reluctant Ataru’s love life!

Helena, is about to give birth and face a rosy future in a modern city, as the pregnant wife of an important factory manager. However, all her illusions soon perish, as the dead body of a newborn intersex baby is found in the middle of their factory.
A young woman from the Valley falls for a punk rocker from the Sunset Strip, leaving her caught in the middle of her lifestyle and love.

Morgan Freeman and Ruby Rose lead in this non-stop actioner from the director of Bad Boys. A retired, crooked police commissioner - Damon Hickley blackmails his caretaker - Victoria by kidnapping her daughter and forces her to help him double cross his former team of dirty cops. Victoria is forced to fight her way through drug dealers and underworld thugs in a bid to save her child.

overview.de: Weihnachts-Familienspaß mit Arnold Schwarzenegger als geplagter Daddy im Geschenkestress: Um seinen Sohn nicht zu enttäuschen, muss er eine ausverkaufte Actionfigur auftreiben - mit allen Mitteln!
overview.en: On Christmas Eve, a frantic father battles all sorts of sordid figures around town to get his hands on the must-have toy of the season for his son.
Fearing that a large shipment of whiskey may not reach its destination, a colonel assigns Captain Paul Slater to safeguard the cargo until it arrives.

title.de: WE WERE – Die Zeit die uns bleibt
title.en: We Were: The Time we have left

overview.de: Katie beginnt das Training als junge Prinzessin in einem kleinen europäischen Land, um sich auf den traditionellen Weihnachtsabend vorzubereiten. Doch sie gerät in Schwierigkeiten mit dem Mädchen, das Ansprüche hat, und ihrem Vater, der mit der Verantwortung als Alleinerziehender klarkommen muss.
overview.en: Katie, a former professional ice skater, is hired by the king of San Senova, Alexander, to help his daughter in a Christmas ice skating performance. As Katie spends time in the castle, she and Alex begin to develop feelings for each other.
A man (Billy Ray Cyrus) bonds with a woman (Gina Holden) who helps his son (Liam James) recover from surgery.

title.de: Welpen zu Weihnachten 2: Pfötchen allein zu Haus
title.en: Christmas with the Pups 2: Pups Alone

overview.en: All does not go as planned for two kids left home alone when a pair of neighbors break in on Christmas and steal their possessions.

title.de: When You Finish Saving the World
title.en: When You Finish Saving the World

overview.en: Evelyn tries to parent a teenager at her shelter while her oblivious son Ziggy fumbles through his pursuit of a brilliant young woman at school.

title.de: Where The Rivers Flow North - Am Ende des Traums

overview.en: A defiant log driver and his American Indian friend resist a power company boss who plans to flood their land, leading to unexpected challenges.
An ex-Marine-turned-mob enforcer must battle his conscience and code of honor when he's forced to clean up his protégé's botched assassination job.
In the Western desert, a young brave avenges the deaths of his tribe after a massacre by the US Army.
Witness the year-long struggle for survival in the Dutch wilderness.
Wild Bill Hickok is a hard-drinking, quick-shooting gunslinger who faces the showdown of his life in this exciting, visually stunning tale.
A news network hires a mercenary to abduct the only surviving Nazi leader who has secrets that could destroy the careers of major political figures.
Special Agent Will Trent has the highest clearance rate in the Georgia Bureau.

When Jenny attends a wedding at a magical ice hotel, she is surprised when she connects with the best man, Craig, and his daughter. Will the romance of the hotel bring them together? Stars Emilie Ullerup and Kevin McGarry.
On Christmas eve, the ghosts of three industrialists return to Earth to help reignite the romantic spark between a young Texas cowboy and teacher.

overview.de: Nach einer anstrengenden Konzerttournee beschließen Aurélien und seine Frau Nanako, die mit ihrem ersten Kind schwanger ist, nach Japan zu ziehen. Als sie sich in einem traditionellen Haus auf dem japanischen Land einrichten, findet Aurélien in einem Brunnen eine alte Rüstung, die seltsame Kreaturen namens Yōkai herbeiruft.
overview.en: Orelsan moves to Japan and finds an ancient armor that awakens strange creatures.

overview.de: In 1997, tensions between religious and secular Turks are rising. Fourteen-year-old Ahmet is sent by his newly converted father to an Islamic boarding school, a "yurt," to learn Muslim values. Ahmet works hard to be a perfect son, but he struggles to fit in with the rough teenagers at the yurt and feels isolated at his secular day school, where he hides his new home from his classmates.
overview.en: In 1997, tensions between religious and secular Turks are rising. Fourteen-year-old Ahmet is sent by his newly converted father to an Islamic boarding school, a "yurt," to learn Muslim values. Ahmet works hard to be a perfect son, but he struggles to fit in with the rough teenagers at the yurt and feels isolated at his secular day school, where he hides his new home from his classmates.
This film tells the story of kung fu brothers Chow and Sii, who agree to carry out a thief's dying wish of taking stolen jewels to his wife.

title.de: Zwei Mann, ein Schwein und die Nacht von Paris

overview.en: Polina Schneider and Soviet creatives travel to Siberia to introduce art to tribes forbidden to interact with foreigners by their gods.

A non-confrontational Jayesh (Ranveer Singh) decides to defy his patriarchal family and flee with his pregnant wife Mudra (Shalini Pandey) to save their unborn daughter from feticide. A screwball, hilarious chase begins as Jayesh's father (Boman Irani) assembles all his might to nab them. Will this unlikely hero manage to create a safe and equal haven for his daughter?

An Indian communications satellite goes off course, raising the potential threat of a major communications disruption worldwide. It is now up to a team of Indian astronauts to course correct the erratic satellite.

Young scientist Kesh along with his invention Kuttaps, a humanoid robot sets out to complete his dad’s invention, Jack and Jill. With the help of his friends, he sets up a lab in a forest and finds a subject Parvathy to test on. But, as the test progress, Parvathy starts landing them in deeper troubles and the success of the invention is at risk.

Innocent days are filled with kindness, at times with bitterness, but are always brimming with light. Mieko and Makio are friends in high school who befriend Eiji, a college student who works with them. Eiji and Makio fall in love, Mieko gives birth to their child, and Makio encounters his old childhood friend Asato. This is a story of youth and their beautiful yet bitter experiences.

overview.de: John Grady Cole, aufgewachsen zwischen wilden Pferden in der rauen Schönheit von Texas, träumt von einem besseren Leben in Mexiko. Als er die Grenze irgendwann tatsächlich hinter sich bringt, warten dort allerdings harte Arbeit und gefährliche Abenteuer auf ihn. Aber auch die Liebe seines Lebens ...
overview.en: An American's dream of living the cowboy way in Mexico turns into a web of murder and betrayal when he falls for the daughter of a dangerous man.

For as long as he can remember, Nathan (Taylor Lautner) has had the uneasy feeling that he's living someone else's life. When he stumbles upon an image of himself as a little boy on a missing persons website, all of Nathan's darkest fears come true.

overview.de: Ein Mann, halb Vampir, halb Sterblicher, wird zum Beschützer der sterblichen Rasse und tötet böse Vampire.
overview.en: A half-vampire, half-mortal man becomes a protector of the mortal race, while slaying evil vampires.

After discovering a video showing what he believes to be his vanished sister Heather, James and a group of friends head into the Black Hills Forest in Maryland, which many believe is connected to the legend of the Blair Witch.

title.de: Bucky Larson: Born to Be a Star
title.en: Bucky Larson: Born to Be a Star

overview.de: A small-town grocery bagger (Nick Swardson) believes he has found his true destiny when he discovers that his conservative parents were once porn stars.
overview.en: An aimless grocery bagger who discovers his conservative parents were once porn stars goes to L.A. hoping to find his destiny in the adult film world.
Follow The Little Ghost on this adventure to see his first sunrise ever!

overview.de: Der Grinch, ein grünes Wesen mit einem Herzen aus Stein, wohnt in den Bergen hoch über dem idyllischen Städtchen Whoville. Übellaunig und verschlagen haßt er eine Sache ganz besonders: fröhliche Menschen, zum Beispiel solche, die sich auf Weihnachten freuen. Also faßt er einen besonders perfiden Plan - er will das Christfest einfach stehlen.
overview.en: A curmudgeon hates the Christmas-loving Whos of Whoville.
Life changes dramatically for a Czech housemaid when the chauffeur gives her three magical hazelnuts.

overview.de: Herzergreifend und saukomisch: originelle Romantikkomödie aus der Schmiede von Comedyguru Judd Apatow ("Beim ersten Mal"). - Ein Jahr, nachdem sie sich kennengelernt haben, verloben sich Edelkoch Tom und Studentin Violet (Jason Segel, Emily Blunt). Aber irgendwie klappt es nie mit der geplanten Hochzeit. Als das Paar ins kalte Michigan umzieht und Tom dafür seinen Job aufgibt, sinkt die Stimmung weiter. Ehe sich die beiden versehen, sind fünf krisenhafte Jahre um - und Violet und Tom müssen noch einmal ganz von vorne anfangen.
overview.en: One year after meeting, Tom proposes to his girlfriend, Violet, but unexpected events keep tripping them up as they look to walk down the aisle together.

title.de: How to Make a Killing: Todsicheres Erbe

overview.de: Becket Redfellow hat Witz, Stil, Bildung und Charme - nur nicht das milliardenschwere Vermögen, das ihm laut seiner Mutter zusteht. Becket entwickelt einen raffiniert-mörderischen Plan, um die sieben Verwandten, die zwischen ihm und dem Erbe stehen, aus dem Weg zu räumen. John Patton Fords Rachethriller besticht mit mörderisch schwarzem Humor und Glen Powell als charismatischem Antihelden.
overview.en: A man will stop at nothing to reclaim his inheritance from his obscenely wealthy family.
Song Ah finds her new musical academic life daunting. One day, she meets Joong Young, a talented pianist.
After bringing her diplomat boyfriend home for the holidays, a teacher gets a big surprise when she learns he's actually the Prince of Madelvia.

overview.de: Mit der IMF aufgelöst, verbünden sich Ethan und sein Team mit einer verleugneten britischen Agentin, die ein Mitglied dieser Geheimorganisation sein könnte und tritt an gegen ein Netzwerk hochqualifizierter Spezialagenten, dem Syndikat.
overview.en: With his organization shut down, agent Ethan Hunt and his team race against time to stop a dangerous network of rogue operatives turned traitors. To defeat them, he must join forces with an elusive agent as he faces his most impossible mission yet.

overview.de: In Odessa haben Gangster eine noch unbekannte, aber hochgefährliche Technologie in ihre Gewalt gebracht und wollen sie nun weiterverkaufen. Agent Orson Fortune und sein Team sollen dies im Auftrag der britischen Regierung verhindern und mehr über diese neue Technologie herausfinden. Die Spur führt zu dem milliardenschweren Waffenhändler Greg Simmonds. Mit Hilfe eines Hollywoodstars will sich Fortune zu diesem Zutritt verschaffen.
overview.en: Special Agent Orson Fortune and his team of agents recruit one of Hollywood's biggest movie stars to help them on a covert mission when the sale of new weapons technology threatens to disrupt world order.

overview.de: Executive Producer Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson presents Power, a crime drama about a nightclub owner who is also the kingpin of a lucrative drug empire.
overview.en: Executive Producer Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson presents the hit drama Power, centered on a drug kingpin struggling to go from illegal to legitimate in the NYC nightlife.

overview.de: „Raising Kanan“ spielt 1991 in South Jamaica, Queens. Es ist ein Prequel zum „Power“-Serienuniversum. In dem Familiendrama geht es um die Jugend von Kanan Stark, einem Kokainhändler mit einem wachsenden Netzwerk von Dealern in ganz New York City.
overview.en: In Season 5, nothing will stand in the way of Kanan's pursuit of power. After all, this isn't the end for Kanan Stark. It's just the beginning.
The story is about a lawyer suffering from hyperthymestic memory syndrome fighting against a huge power to exonerate his father.
Follow the rapid ascent to fame of this British singer/songwriter with the unforgettable voice, from his humble beginnings to the 2015 Grammys.

title.de: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of
title.en: SCTV: The Greatest Show You've Never Heard Of

overview.de: Mecha Elmo, Mecha Abby und Mecha Cookie Monster nutzen ihre Fähigkeiten, um Probleme in der Stadt zu lösen: Wie baut man eine Brücke? Warum schmilzt Schnee? Was muss ein Monster tun, um einen Keks zu bekommen? Die drei entdecken dabei die Eigenschaften ihrer Anzüge und lernen zusammenzuarbeiten.
overview.en: Mecha Elmo, Mecha Cookie Monster and Mecha Abby are ready to problem solve the most out-of-this-world situations. Using their robo-skills, the Mecha Builders are here to help -- it just might take them a few tries before they save the day!
A gifted writer tries to write his next book while his wife begins to attract the attention of another man.

title.de: Thomas & seine Freunde: Wirklich Nützliche Loks
title.en: Thomas & Friends: Railway Stories - Really Helpful Engines

overview.en: When Gordon needs help, Thomas takes on extra work alone to prove himself. But a busy day on Sodor shows that even useful engines need their friends.

overview.de: Gegnerische Alien-Rassen, die Autobots und die Deceptions, bringen ihren Kampf auf die Erde und setzen die Zukunft der Menschheit aufs Spiel.
overview.en: Two intergalactic races of robots crash-land on Earth; the future of humankind hangs in balance.

overview.de: Der Kampf um die Erde geht weiter. Sam Witwicky, der mittlerweile aufs College geht, erfährt die Wahrheit über die geschichtlichen Ursprünge der Transformers. Er muss sein Schicksal annehmen und gemeinsam mit Optimus Prime und Bumblebee den gewaltigen Kampf aufnehmen - gegen die Decepticons, die stärker als zuvor zurückgekehrt sind, mit dem Plan, unsere Welt zu zerstören.
overview.en: Sam Witwicky (Shia LaBeouf) holds the key to defeating an ancient Decepticon.

overview.de: Ein geheimnisvolles Ereignis der jüngsten Vergangenheit droht, einen Krieg von solchen Ausmaßen zu entfesseln, dass die Transformers ohne Hilfe nicht in der Lage sein werden, den Planeten zu retten. Sam Witwicky (Shia LaBeouf) und die Autobots müssen in diesem Riesenerfolg von Regisseur Michael Bay und ausführendem Produzenten Steven Spielberg erneut antreten, um unsere Welt gegen das alles verzehrende Böse der Decepticons zu verteidigen!
overview.en: Sam Witwicky once again joins the battle between Autobots and Decepticons.

overview.de: Regisseur Michael Bay und Produzent Steven Spielberg liefern uns den besten 'Transformers' aller Zeiten! Die Menschheit steht durch eine schreckliche neue Bedrohung kurz vor der Ausrottung und es liegt an Optimus Prime und den Autobots, die Welt zu retten. Aber da unsere Regierung sie ächtete, brauchen sie ein neues Team aus Verbündeten, darunter den Erfinder Cade Yeager (Mark Wahlberg) und die fürchterlichen Dinobots!
overview.en: As humanity picks up the pieces after an epic battle, a shadowy group emerges to control history.

overview.de: Von Regisseur Michael Bay und Produzent Steven Spielberg kommt der bisher gewaltigste, explosivste Transformers. Der größte Held unserer Welt wird zu unserem erbittertsten Feind, wenn Optimus Prime eine Mission startet, bei der die Erde zerstört wird, um Cybertron zu retten. Jetzt müssen Bumblebee und Cade Yeager (Mark Wahlberg) die Autobots gegen ihren einstigen Verbündeten in die ultimative Schlacht führen, um die Menschheit vor ihrer Vernichtung zu bewahren.
overview.en: When Optimus Prime turns against mankind, Bumblebee leads the Autobots into a battle to save Earth.

overview.de: In der Vorweihnachtszeit kehrt Amelia Hughes, eine karriereorientierte App-Entwicklerin aus Chicago, die so gar nicht in Weihnachtsstimmung ist, in ihr Heimatstädtchen Christmas Creek zurück, um die Bedeutung von Weihnachten wiederzuentdecken. Dort trifft sie ihren besten Freund aus der Kindheit, Mike, und ihren entfremdeten Onkel, Harry, dessen rätselhaftes Zerwürfnis mit Amelias Vater ihre Familie während der Weihnachtszeit entzweit hat, als sie noch ein Kind war. Während sie sich an den örtlichen Weihnachtsfeierlichkeiten beteiligt - und sich langsam in Mike verliebt -, kehrt die Weihnachtsstimmung in Amelias Herz zurück.
overview.en: A young CEO returns to her hometown to reconnect with friends and family.

title.de: แก๊งโอเวอร์

overview.en: Idiot, middle-aged employee, loser daddy, and workaholic Young Soo suddenly encounters death by overwork. Gi Tak, once a mob boss who washed his hands of gang life and now runs a pub, also ends up leaving this world due to an unjust accident. Both meet in the afterlife as they board a train bound for heaven but quickly decide to jump off together as they aren't ready to say goodbye. They wish to return to mortal life in order to leave their loved ones in good hands, so they make a deal with an angel to reincarnate. The kind Young Soo returns as a total hardbody and Gi Tak as a beautiful young woman, but both soon end up running into difficulties as the bodies they're reborn into have problems of their own!
After talking online, a writer and a chef's budding romance begins when they meet in real life. However, they quickly find out how little they know about each other.
Jung Woo's peaceful prosecutor life is rattled by a murder on his daughter's 6th birthday. Will justice be served for the loves of his life?

overview.de: Historienaction meets Mysteryhorror: Nicolas Cage und Ron Perlman bringen als Kreuzritter eine vermeintliche Hexe zum Prozess - und müssen gegen finstere Mächte kämpfen.
overview.en: Two Teutonic Knights return from the Crusades and must escort a witch blamed for the Black Plague to a distant abbey whose monks will lift her curse.
The image of the human body was that the brain is the command center and the other organs obey the orders from the brain. We now know more.

overview.de: Ein ehemaliger C.I.A.-Mitarbeiter wird auf eine sehr persönliche Mission zurückgebracht und befindet sich in einem tödlichen Spiel mit hochrangigen C.I.A.-Funktionären und dem designierten russischen Präsidenten gegen seinen ehemaligen Schüler.
overview.en: Five years into his retirement, CIA veteran Peter Devereaux (Pierce Brosnan) is pulled back into service to help retrieve a Russian agent -- also his former lover -- who has incriminating evidence on Federov, a corrupt Russian leader. When a different CIA team, led by Devereaux's former protege (Luke Bracey), shows up, the mission goes south and Devereaux's ex-lover is killed. Now a rogue agent...

title.de: Tyler Perry's The Gospel of Christmas
title.en: Tyler Perry's The Gospel of Christmas

title.de: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County
title.en: The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives: Orange County

overview.en: Vijay, a commonwealth gold medal winner's boxing career and personal life sees a downslide after failing the dope test. Will he be able to rise again?
Old friends and old flames get together at their 10-year high school reunion, each with some unfinished business from the past.

title.de: 2021: War of the Worlds – Invasion from Mars

overview.en: Sibling astronomers, who discover that Martians are targeting the Earth, team up with the military once the aliens begin attacking New York City.
Having been left for dead with 22 bullets in his body after being shot by a former childhood friend, a retired mobster sets out to get his revenge.

Cody Banks (Frankie Muniz) is a teenager recruited by the CIA to help stop an evil mastermind set on world domination, but he’s also falling for a girl in his classes, Natalie (Hilary Duff). Can he save the world, get the girl…and not miss curfew?

title.de: Akropolis Bonjour - Monsieur Thierry macht Urlaub

overview.de: Seit Thierry Hamelin in Rente ist und die Kinder aus dem Haus sind, hat er nur noch eine Obsession - Familienfotos zu digitalisieren. Seine Familie ist genervt. Thierrys Frau, die Ärztin Claire, hat schon lange das Gefühl, dass aus ihrer Ehe die Luft raus ist. Als sie die Scheidung will, fasst Thierry einen Plan: Er will mit ihnen noch einmal den Familienurlaub in Griechenland 1998 nachstellen…
overview.en: Thierry's wife Claire wants to leave him. In a desperate effort to save his marriage Thierry ropes in Claire and the two grown-up children to spend a vacation in Greece exactly as they did on a legendary trip 30 years ago.
A mousy, pampered woman who married well tries to find herself and contemplates the unthinkable--an extramarital affair.
A city journalist sent on an assignment back to her hometown for a Fourth of July story finds the missing piece to her life in her first love.

overview.de: Fummel-Fun vom Feinsten: In der Fortsetzung der Apfelkuchen-Saga ziehen Jason Biggs, Seann William Scott und ihre Freunde erneut in eine Reihe chaotischer Sex-Abenteuer. - Um ihre Semesterferien gebührend zu feiern, versammelt sich Jim, Stifler und ihre Clique in einem Ferienhaus zu einer Dauerparty. Ihr Ziel: Ein Gefäß mit Kondomen soll bis Ende des Sommers geleert sein. Doch statt der Nonstop-Sexorgie erleben die Jungs nur einige kleine und viele große Missgeschicke.
overview.en: The gang are back for another slice of comedy, as they celebrate spring break. Seann William Scott, Jason Biggs and Alyson Hannigan return. Strong language/sex. (2001)(107 mins)

A Hallmark Channel original movie. A speech writer (Tyler Hynes) makes a deal with his ex-girlfriend (Bethany Joy Lenz) to pretend they’re a couple to save his family’s Christmas. It’s not long before both the ruse and their feelings catch up with them.
The tale of the Russian royal whose world changed forever when the evil Rasputin destroyed her family. How will she take control of her destiny?
Five astronauts whose space shuttle crash lands on Earth after a Mars mission face a desperate and scary race against time for their ultimate rescue.

Ali is a fisherman in a seaside village where he has to work hard not to lose the restaurant from his parents. One day Deniz comes to the village. Nobody knows who she is or where she is going. A love develops between Ali and Deniz.
After an imprisoned U-boat commander pulls off a violent rebellion of fellow POWs against British jailers, the camp is assigned a tough new captain.
Why should big kids have all the fun? It’s not fair! From flying bikes to cupcake making and camping, Emma and her friends get to do ALL the things big kids get to do.

Woody Allen's humor is at his wild and bizarre best in this story of a "weird-gadget" tester who, after being jilted by his girlfriend (Louise Lasser), ends up as president of a tiny country where absurdity reigns.

This 4x Emmy & Peabody award-winning musical production presents a dazzling display of talent by legendary ballet dancer Mikhail Baryshnikov as he takes on the best of Broadway, including numbers from Oklahoma!, Fiddler on the Roof, Can-Can, The King and I, Cabaret, Hello Dolly, Ain't Misbehavin', Guys and Dolls, Kiss Me Kate, and A Chorus Line. Featuring Liza Minelli and a superb Broadway cast.

overview.de: Teenager-Liebesdrama von den Machern der "After"-Reihe: Studentin Abby lässt sich mit Untergrund-Boxer Travis auf eine Wette ein. Gewinnt er den nächsten Kampf, zieht sie bei ihm ein.
overview.en: A gifted card player hopes for a fresh start at college, but her troubled Vegas past resurfaces as she falls for an underground fighter.
Out for vengeance against the men who committed an orphan massacre, a trio of nuns hang up their habits to settle a scores decades in the making.

Biswa Kalyan Rath, is a comedian who used to be angry at the world. Now he is disappointed. In this special, shot in London because London is on Earth and he is a human of Earth, he explores various themes on how the world is an irritating place. On second thought he’s still angry but that’s none of your business unless you are also angry, in which case please watch. Enjoy. Or don’t. Any problem?
Pursued by a dangerous criminal after a failed theft, con artists Nina and Yaz get more than they bargained for when they target an elderly widow.

title.en: The Adventures of the Black Stallion

overview.de: Auf der Suche nach seinem Lebenszweck stößt Jaime Reyes auf uralte Biotechnologie, die ihm Kräfte verleiht, sein Schicksal verändert und ihn zum Superhelden Blue Beetle macht.
overview.en: An ancient relic of alien biotechnology bestows a young man with a powerful suit of armor.

overview.de: Kyoto, 1863. Nio, ein junger Waisenjunge mit durchdringenden blauen Augen und einem ausgeprägten Gerechtigkeitssinn, strebt danach, diese Gesellschaft grundlegend zu verändern. Seine Begegnung mit Toshizô Hijikata und Sôji Okita, zwei Ronin, entfacht in ihm erneut die glühende Rebellion, die bereit ist, die ganze Nation in Flammen zu setzen.
overview.en: Inspired by the efforts of the so-called Blues Wolves of Mibu, Nio decides to join the ranks to help carve a path to the world he wishes to see.
The magical true tale of a father and son, who helped put California’s wine country on the map during the infamous, blind Paris wine tasting of 1976.

overview.de: Der für seinen Berufsstand zu groß geratene Elf Buddy wird vom Weihnachtsmann in die USA geschickt, um seine wahre Identität herauszufinden.
overview.en: As a baby, Buddy is whisked off to the North Pole, and raised as an elf. A misfit in his family, Buddy heads to his birthplace to seek out his roots.
When mysterious alien ships appear in the sky, a scientist is sealed in an underground bunker and must create a bio-weapon to stop the invasion.
Cake is the story of a talented baker trying to win the heart of the woman he loves, by using his culinary gift. Soon he finds out that relationships are just like cake, are layered and complex.
Charlie and Itchy travel from heaven to Earth, where they meet a runaway boy while on their mission to retrieve the Angel Gabriel's stolen horn.
A canine criminal tries to ruin Christmas for everyone by stealing presents. He’s then visited by three ghosts who persuade him to change his ways.

title.de: Charlie's Christmas Wish - Ein Weihnachtsfest der Hoffnung

overview.en: A war veteran finds inspiration in his son’s spirited new terrier, who helps bring the town together in time to build homes for displaced veterans.

Over the course of a long Berlin summer night, three stories intertwine. Mia, an aspiring French dancer has to re-invent herself after both her love and dreams are shattered. Keks, a local DJ, escapes into the Berlin party night until reality forces her eyes open. And video performance artist Ian is for the first time in love, but also rejected and he doesn't know how to deal with it.

title.de: Christmas Candle - Das Licht der Weihnachtsnacht

overview.en: A pastor, who has suffered a personal loss, accepts a position in a town that believes in a Christmas miracle candle, which he strives to abolish.

title.de: Cindy aus Marzahn - Nicht jeder Prinz kommt uff'm Pferd
title.en: Cindy aus Marzahn - Nicht jeder Prinz kommt uff'm Pferd

overview.en: Taking the audience on an all-access tour of music inspired video, showcasing the funniest, loudest, best, craziest, hottest, wildest stories of people and their music.
A lifelong coffee farmer decides to change his rural life at 40, venturing into the city in search of love and navigating its complexities.
A man and woman flirt with each other at a wedding reception, which leads to a night of passion, which reveals a deeper tale of romance and remorse.
A 20-something slacker gets caught up in a deadly game of cat and mouse after answering a 'For Sale' sign placed on a dilapidated van.

title.de: Curse of the Forty-Niner - Die Rache des Jeremiah Stone

overview.en: A group of friends discover gold deep inside an old mine. But by taking the gold and think they've hit it big, they awaken a long dead miner who's Hell Bent on protecting his treasure.

Katha is sure. She wants to marry Jana and she wants to have a baby with her. But Kathas childhood friend Charly has a special surprise for her. A bachelorettes night out with the guys. A weekend. The five of them. On a raft. There is Ken, her new best friend, her little brother Tobi and Momo the future sperm donor. This is bound to end badly.
Reporter Kendra Adams searches for the love story behind an antique engagement ring with the help of the grandson of the ring's owner.

title.de: Das Paradies am Ende der Berge
title.en: Das Paradies am Ende der Berge

overview.en: From acclaimed director Patrice Leconte ("Girl on the Bridge"), "Yvonne's Perfume" is a mysterious and romantic drama of desire. In the early 1950s, on the shores of a lake wedged between France and Switzerland, a trio of holiday travelers meet, clash, and fall in and out of friendship and love. Adapted from the novel Ville Triste by Nobel Prize-winner Patrick Modiano.

title.de: Das wundersame Weihnachtsfest des Karl-Bertil Jonsson

overview.en: La historia real de cuatro jóvenes cantantes reunidos por NBC como un grupo de canto para ser la alternativa estadounidense a los Beatles.
An elite commando strike squad storms an isolated San Carlos drug fortress to battle an iron-fisted cocaine czar and free his American DEA hostages.
After Bobo, a clumsy but well-meaning dwarf, pricks Sleeping Beauty, he accidentally sends the whole kingdom into an enchanted slumber.

overview.de: Ein junger Maler, Max, entdeckt ein Tagebuch, das einst Amedeo Modigliani gehörte, und findet sich bald in demselben tragischen Schicksal wieder wie der legendäre Künstler. Während Max mit Sucht, Selbstzerstörung und komplizierten Beziehungen kämpft, wird er zunehmend von Modiglianis dunklem Weg verschlungen, unfähig, dem Fluch seiner Vergangenheit zu entkommen.
overview.en: A young painter, Max, discovers a diary once owned by Amedeo Modigliani and soon finds himself spiraling into the same tragic fate as the legendary artist. As Max struggles with addiction, self-destruction, and complicated relationships, he becomes increasingly consumed by Modigliani's dark path, unable to escape the curse of his past.
An impossible gold heist aboard a moving train planned by a master criminal with a carefully assembled team shocks Victorian society to its core.
A revenge one-night stand with a stranger for a spurned bride-to-be turns into much more when her fling falls in love and refuses to let her go.

1967. The time of the Cultural Revolution. Chen Zhen, a young student from Beijing, is sent to Inner Mongolia to teach a nomadic tribe of shepherds. But it is Chen who has much to learn – about existence in this enormous, harsh and breathtakingly beautiful wilderness, about community, freedom and responsibility, and about the most feared and revered creature of the steppes – the wolf. Seduced by the complex and near-mystical bond between these sacred creatures and the herdsmen, fascinated by their cunning, their strength, their ferocious beauty, he captures a cub and tries to tame it. But the growing relationship between man and animal – as well as the tribe's ancient way of life, and the land itself – is threatened when a ruthless central government officer decides to eliminate all wolves from the region, whatever the cost.
After Inspector Clouseau mysteriously disappears, a reporter interviews friends and foes who reminisce about the bungling sleuth via flashbacks.
After Ellie dumps her boozehound husband and falls for a local doctor, a series of bizarre incidents begin to threaten her and her daughter.

title.en: The Son of the White Mountain

overview.en: Young Ivan's newfound love of board games catapults him into the fantastical and competitive world of game invention and pits him against enemies.

Brad was the world's greatest spy, charming, deadly and unstoppable, until he met his one true love and tried to leave the world of espionage behind forever. His plans soon get turned upside down when a rogue agent kidnaps his girlfriend and steals several hypersonic missiles, forcing Brad to save his lover and the world one last time..

title.de: Desert Force - Entscheidung in der Wüste

overview.en: An explosion in Beirut supposedly kills a Marine captain.  Back in the United States, his twin brother, Chris Brandt, receives the news. Chris shares an almost extra-sensory connection with his brother and senses that he's still alive.  Chris travels to Beirut and visits the American Embassy.  A Consular Liason says that he will investigate his brother's death, but urges Chris to return to the US.  Undeterred, Chris continues the search and discovers that his brother is being held prisoner by an anti-American terrorist group.  Chris infiltrates the camp and frees his brother.

title.de: Diana - Ein Leben für die Liebe

overview.en: In an interview, Lady Diana Spencer tells the failure of her marriage to Prince Charles, sthocking the monarchy and the world with their infidelities.
Yang Hu Yun is asked to escort the cargo transportation of gold taels, which becomes targeted by a criminal organization led by the Golden Arm Kid.

As the social fabric of life in rural India disintegrates in the late 1990s, journalist Manav Banerjee (Sharman Joshi) moves with his pregnant wife to the State of Orissa in hope of a better life and the promise of a lucrative career. When speculation mounts that local Australian missionary Graham Staines (Stephen Baldwin) is illegally proselytizing leprosy patients, Manav agrees to investigate undercover for the newspaper. What he finds is a series of revelations that are difficult to fathom and even harder to explain, and Manav is forced to make a choice between his own ambition and the truth. In the end, his actions spark a tragic event that is felt around the world. Based on a true story and shot on location in India, "The Least Of These" beautifully illustrates the power of love, hope and forgiveness to overcome hate.
Two childhood friends face the adventure of matrimony to inherit a treasured restaurant, unknowingly seeking their perfect match in each other.

overview.de: Nach einer schwierigen Scheidung hat der 40-jährige Lucas eine neue Freundin, einen neuen Job und arbeitet hart daran, die Beziehung zu Marcus, seinem Sohn im Teenageralter, wieder herzustellen. Doch die Dinge gehen schief. Nur eine Geschichte - eine zufällige Lüge. Und als der Schnee fällt und die Weihnachtslichter leuchten, verbreitet sich die Lüge wie ein Virus. Der Schock und das Misstrauen geraten außer Kontrolle, und die kleine Gemeinde findet sich plötzlich in einem kollektiven Zustand der Hysterie, während Lucas einen einsamen Kampf um sein Leben und seine Würde führt. Die Hexenjagd beginnt...
overview.en: A man trying to regroup after losing his job and facing a divorce is shattered when a lie about him throws his community into mass hysteria.

title.en: The Hunt for the Amber Room

overview.en: In 13th century Eastern Europe, one amnesiac warrior leads a small army of 17 fearless men to defend their land against the invading Mongol Empire.
An international opiate-trafficking ring controlled by powerful businessmen is busted wide open by vigilantes in this suspenseful crime thriller.
In Medieval France, a warrior returns home after four years of war and captivity. It is his delicate daughter who must deal now with his rage and frustration.

Alexei Fedorovic Vlassov, a Soviet spy colonel, abducts two officials from his country and seeks political asylum in the United States. Transported from Paris to New York, he reveals - after having been subjected to the "lie detector test" - the names of some Soviet spies nested in the high command of NATO and in the French secret service...

A CIA interrogator is enlisted to investigate an imminent terrorist threat, but she soon uncovers a much deeper plot of deception. With the help of a former soldier, she must race against time to stop a deadly biological attack. Starring Noomi Rapace, Orlando Bloom, Toni Collette, John Malkovich, and Michael Douglas. Directed by Michael Apted; screenplay by Peter O'Brien.

title.de: Die Suche nach dem wunderbunten Vögelchen
title.en: In Search of the Magical Bird

overview.en: Toward the end of the Ching Dynasty, the South China Sea was swarming with pirates looking to plunder treasure-rich Portuguese merchant ships. A titanic tale of a daring and heroic "Robin Hood" of the seas.

title.de: Dieter Nuhr - Wer’s glaubt, wird selig
title.en: Dieter Nuhr - Wer’s glaubt, wird selig

overview.en: After falling victim to a scam, a desperate man races the clock as he attempts to plan a luxurious destination wedding for an important investor.
A hard-partying fashion editor headed for a nervous breakdown gets a new identity but ends up a murder suspect when her past returns to haunt her.
Four of the world’s best fighters are invited to a martial arts contest, where they learn the sinister real intentions of the tournament.
A loyal cop is determined to avenge the death of his partner, but his investigation is complicated by a bizarre and intricate conspiracy.

Melissa Gilbert, Brian Wimmer, Lindy Newton, Lindsay Wagner. Intense, unhappy female lawyer discovers she has an unknown half-sister who lives on an impoverished horse ranch, a portal to an entirely new kind of life. Closed-captioned.
Uprooted from Chicago to a beach town after his dad’s death, aimless and lonely Jake meets a surf shop owner with a thrilling secret about his family.
The adventures of Inspector Clouseau continue as the bumbling sleuth tries to prove a beautiful parlor maid innocent of killing her chauffeur lover.

overview.de: Eine Handvoll unerschrockener Mädels gründet das erste Frauen-Baseball-Team der Welt - die Rockford Peaches. Als "Botschafterinnen des Charmes und weiblicher Schönheit" sollten sie antreten. Doch Coach Jimmy Dugan (Tom Hanks), der ständig beschwipste Alt-Star, hat andere Ziele. Er bringt die Truppe mit unerbittlicher Härte auf Vordermann. Zuschauern wie Gegnern vergeht angesichts des wilden Ha..
overview.en: The All-American Girls Professional Baseball League begins in 1943 with a has-been as a manager.
A man tries to find a seat for a show, while another man harasses both patrons and performers.

When a celebrity chef walks off his show, prep cook Anna must step into the spotlight and make the show her own, with the help of her Aussie cameraman and Portuguese location scout. Stars Heather Hemmens, Luke Mitchell.
After a man is assigned to downsize a Nebraska tractor plant factory, he falls for a local single mother, but their newfound romance hits trouble.

overview.de: In season one, athlete pranks include the NFL's Baker Mayfield from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who goes undercover to blow the minds of Bucs diehards.
overview.en: In season one, athlete pranks include the NFL's Baker Mayfield from the Tampa Bay Buccaneers, who goes undercover to blow the minds of Bucs diehards.

title.en: How to Stop Being a Loser

overview.en: ‘How to Stop Being a Loser’ is a warm comedy about James who is the consummate dork and makes Ronnie Corbett look like a modern day Don Juan. Eventually, pick up artist Ampersand comes to James’ rescue and teaches him the way of the woman. But as James learns the dark art of seduction from his mentor he begins to wonder if Ampersand is all he appears to be and questions what would truly make him happy in life.
During a company retreat, sparks fly between aspiring partner and single mom Alice and the manny she hired to look after her nine-year-old daughter.

title.en: Humanist Vampire Seeking Consenting Suicidal Person

overview.en: Sasha is a young vampire who is too sensitive to kill. When her exasperated parents cut off her blood supply, Sasha meets Paul, a lonely teenager who is willing to give his life to save hers. But their friendly agreement soon becomes a nocturnal quest to fulfill Paul’s last wishes before day breaks.
After a psychic’s chilling predictions upend his life, a man becomes consumed by fear and paranoia, unsure if fate or madness is closing in on him.

title.de: Franz Schubert – Ein Leben in zwei Sätzen
title.en: Franz Schubert – Ein Leben in zwei Sätzen

title.de: Free Birds - Esst uns an einem anderen Tag

overview.en: Two turkeys from opposite sides of the tracks must put aside their differences and team up to travel back in time to change the course of history - and get turkey off the holiday menu for good.

overview.de: Terror reloaded: das Hollywood-Remake von Michael Hanekes radikalem Thriller von 1997. Zwei Psychopathen treiben brutale Spiele mit Naomi Watts. - Ann und George Farber (Naomi Watts, Tim Roth) wollen gemeinsam mit ihrem kleinen Sohn einige Tage in ihrem Ferienhaus am See verbringen. Doch unvermittelt zerstören zwei junge Männer (Brady Corbet, Michael Pitt) die Idylle: Brutal nehmen sie die Familie gefangen, terrorisieren und misshandeln sie. Für die Farbers beginnt ein Albtraum, aus dem es kein Erwachen gibt.
overview.en: Two psychotic young men take a family hostage in their holiday home.

Two years have gone by. Vincent and Flo Leroy, now divorced, are next-door neighbors in Bordeaux, where they raise their four children while trying to start their lives over again. Each ex-spouse cordially hates the other’s new partner. But things would be manageable if the children hadn’t decided to wage a war of attrition to eliminate their soon-to-be step-parents.

title.de: Grow Up!? - Erwachsen werd' ich später

overview.en: A woman stuck in permanent adolescence lies to her fiancé about going on a retreat and spends the time hanging out with teenagers instead.

overview.de: Um seiner Familie ein besseres Leben zu bieten, arbeitet Ex-Cop Ray Hayes als Schuldeneintreiber für das organisierte Verbrechen. Fünf Jahre später steht er kurz davor, mit Ehefrau Alice ein Diner zu eröffnen. Doch ein neuer Gangsterboss bringt alles ins Wanken – in einer chaotischen Nacht kämpfen sie nicht nur ums Überleben, sondern auch darum, ihre Familie zu retten!
overview.en: When a job goes horribly wrong, an ex-cop and family man (Kevin James) who moonlights as a mob henchman has one night to get his family out of the city.

overview.de: Seitdem die vier Urgötter mit den niederen Göttern geflohen sind, ist die Welt, in der Gottheiten, Unsterbliche und Menschen koexistieren, in Gefahr. Es gilt das Aussterben aller Lebensformen zu verhindern. Deswegen begeben sich Ichiyô und sein Schüler Tenkô auf eine gefährliche Reise, um die Flüchtigen zu verfolgen und mythische Kreaturen von ihren Ketten zu befreien.
overview.en: Caught in the midst of chaos, Ichiyo and Tenko band together to prevent an impending catastrophe in this epic action-fantasy manga series.
An unstable war veteran with a savior complex receives a shocking wake-up call upon returning stateside and accepting a position in Homeland Security.
A real estate agent finds herself in competition with a developer when he approaches her family about buying their historic estate.

overview.de: Al Pacino jagt als Detective Vincent Hanna einen skrupellosen Gangsterboss.
overview.en: A group of professional bank robbers start to feel the heat from police when they unknowingly leave a clue at their latest heist.
A sexy starpilot pursues the power-crazed maniac who destroyed her homeworld and kidnapped her sister in this sequel to 1981 cult classic Heavy Metal.
Henry (Keanu Reeves), a man seemingly without ambition, dreams or purpose, gets a wake-up call early one morning when he becomes an unwitting participant in an ill-conceived bank heist.
Romance blossoms between an undocumented Senegalese immigrant working in Paris and the insomniac caseworker trying to keep him in the country.
Lauren and Ned have just ten days until their wedding to find Lauren's mother who has gone AWOL somewhere in the remote far north of Australia.
Four wingmates, 1 Hostel, First Semester. 'Hostel Daze' tries to capture the hostel-culture (or its lack thereof) of an engineering college.

title.de: Hot Tub - Der Whirlpool... ist 'ne verdammte Zeitmaschine!

overview.de: "Zurück in die Zukunft" meets "Hangover": In der schrillen Kultkomödie werden John Cusack und seine Loser-Kumpels von einem Hotel-Whirlpool ins Jahr 1986 transportiert.
overview.en: A malfunctioning time machine sends a man, his friends, and his nephew back to a pivotal night, where they must ensure the nephew is born.

When a drug bust goes wrong, notorious ex-cop Danny Gallagher's (Karl Urban) quest for justice leads him to the car-bomb murder of a government official's wife. He finds himself under fire when he discovers the woman's secret lover.

Brigitte Bardot stars in this madcap romantic comedy, seen through the fetishizing lens of Roger Vadim. Sophie (Bardot), a flighty young model, learns that her boyfriend is planning to leave her for another woman. She resolves to either win him back or assassinate her rival. A handsome doctor assists her with the former plan so that she won't have to resort to the latter.
In this prequel, a Hong Kong cop begins his infiltration of the Triads.
Clouseau attempts to outwit ten lookalikes who are robbing banks all over Switzerland as Alan Arkin takes his comedic turn as the ever-chaotic sleuth.
A rival of a trigger-happy detective is his last hope to find the killer of his fiancée after he loses a vital battle of wits with a serial killer.

Jackie Jencquel, author and activist, is not terminally ill when she announces her death date—she simply refuses to live beyond a certain age. This unconventional conversation between a mother and her son, the filmmaker, tackles desire, personal autonomy, vanity and money.
A covert desert base of elite commandos and Russian-engineered dinosaurs become Earth’s last hope against a mad warlord with a nuclear arsenal.

In the rolling hills of the Italian countryside lives Bruno, a mammoth donkey with a heart bigger than his strength. Through storms and sorrow, through cruelty and loss, Bruno refuses to give up. His journey is filled with friends, laughter, tears, and wonder as he inspires others, breaks the chains of captivity, and discovers that love and courage can light even the darkest path.

In Kabukicho, home of Tokyo's famous red-light district, the bright neon conceals the darkest of evils. Mrs Hudson's tenement boasts a set of detectives, including the brilliant Sherlock Holmes, eager to solve cases for the right price.

At Kamp Koral, the craziest sleepaway camp in the kelp forest, 10-year-old SpongeBob SquarePants and his pals spend the summer building underwater campfires, catching wild jellyfish, and swimming in Lake Yuckymuck.
In the 1880s, a British-commanded Egyptian army is tasked with defending the capital of Sudan from an invading army comprised of Muslim zealots.
A young woman comes back to South Africa to run her late father's fishing company and save her community from losing their livelihood.

King Laurin tells a story, embedded in a famous South Tyrolean legend about King Laurin and his myth-enshrouded rose garden. Inbetween the legend's heroic figures, like Dietrich, Hildebrand, Similde and of course Dwarf King Laurin, the film tells the story of Theo. Theo is King Dietrich's son and successor to the throne, who appears to be too small and too weak to fulfill his father's hopes.
A sheltered young man joins Alcoholics Anonymous to get closer to the woman of his dreams -- a former hooker and stripper named Krystal.
A famous pop singer is stuck in a small Nevada town, where two fledgling songwriters beg a cocktail waitress to charm him into looking at their work.

Not everything is as it seems for Cristi, a policeman who plays both sides of the law. Embarking with the beautiful Gilda on a high-stakes heist, both will have to navigate the twists and turns of corruption, treachery and deception.
A nun with a passion for music teaches young women at a small convent school in Quebec, despite larger changes happening within the Church.
The most iconic dog in film history returns! Lassie's detective skills are put to the ultimate test in this thrilling new crime-busting adventure.

title.de: LOL: Last One Laughing Halloween UK
title.en: LOL: Last One Laughing Halloween UK

title.de: LOL: Last One Laughing Nederland - Halloween Special
title.en: LOL: Last One Laughing Netherlands - Halloween Special

overview.en: August 4th 2023. 9:12pm. Party Night. One single shot. Is it a bad trip? Or is it something else? One thing is for sure, it's only the beginning of the night.

overview.de: Chicago, im Jahre 1929. Trotz des Alkoholverbots gibt es eine Menge 'Flüsterkneipen' für durstige Leute. Eine davon gehört dem Gangsterboss Gamaschen-Colombo (George Raft), der sein Unternehmen als 'Beerdigungs-Institut' tarnt. Als die Polizei dahinterkommt, hebt sie das Etablissement aus. So verlieren die beiden Musiker Joe (Tony Curtis) und Jerry (Jack Lemmon) ihren Job. Kurz darauf werden sie unfreiwillig Zeu- gen, wie Gamaschen-Colombo mehrere Unterwelt-Konkurrenten umbringen lässt Auf der Flucht vor den Gangstern, die Joe und Jerry als Mitwisser ebenfalls unschädlich machen wollen, haben die beiden einen verrückten Einfall: sie verkleiden sich als Frauen, um einen Platz in einer Damenkapelle zu bekommen. Aus Jerry wird 'Daphne', aus Joe 'Josephine'. Auf der Fahrt zu einem Gastspiel in Miami freundet sich Jerry im Schlafwagen mit der blonden Sugar (Marilyn Monroe) an. Joe findet ebenfalls Gefallen an der aufregenden Sängerin, die unbedingt einen Millionär heiraten möchte. So entschließt sich Joe in Miami zu einem komplizierten Doppelspiel. Tagsüber präsentiert er sich Sugar als Besitzer einer großen Jacht, die in Wirklichkeit dem millionenschweren alten Playboy Osgood Fielding III (Joe E. Brown) gehört. Sugar ahnt nicht, daß der angebliche Öl-Erbe und ihre Kollegin 'Josephine' in Wirklichkeit ein und dieselbe Person sind, und verliebt sich heftig. Jerry alias 'Daphne' wiederum muß sich von Osgood den Hof machen lassen. Ganz verrückt wird es schließlich, als Gamaschen-Colombo zu einem Gangster-Kongress in Miami aufkreuzt.
overview.en: After witnessing a mob hit, two Chicago musicians head South disguised as female jazz artists. Their cover seems perfect…until love comes along.

overview.de: Der New Yorker Skandal-Journalist Porter Wren (Adrien Brody) ist ständig auf der Suche nach Morden, Tragödien und allem, was sich als „Story“ für Zeitungen verkaufen lässt. Zuhause ist er der ideale Ehemann und Vater. Aber dann wird er von einer schönen, geheimnisvollen Frau durch ein Versprechen verführt – er soll ihr helfen, den Mord an ihrem Ehemann aufzuklären und gerät dadurch in den Sog der dunklen Seite von Manhattan. Der engagierte Berichterstatter menschlicher Katastrophen wird nun selbst zum Opfer und unfreiwilligen Täter.
overview.en: When a widow asks a journalist to solve the death of her filmmaker husband, the inquiry draws him into a world of adultery, blackmail and murder.
Perry, a sheltered chemical engineer, falls in love with Leslie, a former homecoming princess, when he becomes a jury member at her hippie death cult murder trial.
An honest cop, a conman and a hopeless romantic form an unusual team during the days of demonetisation to pull off a scam. A scam that is bigger than demonetisation, but things go haywire.

overview.de: MuMu, ein katzenförmiger Außerirdischer, ist aus dem fernen Weltraum auf die Erde gekommen. Sein Ziel ist es, die Technologie der Haushaltsgeräte auf der Erde zu erlernen, um die Technologie zurückzugewinnen, die seine eigene Spezies verloren hat. Dadurch wird das gewöhnliche Universitätsleben von Sakurako komplett auf den Kopf gestellt!
overview.en: MuMu, ein katzenförmiger Außerirdischer, ist aus dem fernen Weltraum auf die Erde gekommen. Sein Ziel ist es, die Technologie der Haushaltsgeräte auf der Erde zu erlernen, um die Technologie zurückzugewinnen, die seine eigene Spezies verloren hat. Dadurch wird das gewöhnliche Universitätsleben von Sakurako komplett auf den Kopf gestellt!
After surviving a megalodon attack, a ship's crew are once again imperiled as a frenzy of five of the giant creatures torments the open ocean.
A boy’s lovable pet, created by a botched experiment, grows larger and more mischievous as the boy and his pals try to keep the military police away.

Mia, a young, attractive woman and mother starts to question the meaning of life due to external circumstances. She tries to escape into the virtual world of chats, where she meets „Morgenrot" for the first time. It is the beginning of a journey through the unknown, where feelings don't emerge through physical contact, but through words. However, Mia's husband discovers her secret.

Acquitted in life, back on trial after death. Close friends, former staff and researchers paint an intimate portrait of Jackson's complicated world and put allegations of sexual abuse under the microscope.

title.de: Mila und Ruslan – Mutiger als erlaubt

overview.en: A wandering artist who dreams of becoming a knight must rescue his love, a beautiful princess, when she's kidnapped by an evil sorcerer.

Best friends Alice and Celine both live an idyllic traditional lifestyle, but life’s perfect harmony is suddenly shattered after a tragic accident. Guilt, suspicion and paranoia unravel their sisterly bond and a psychological battle begins.

overview.de: Jeder kennt und liebt ihn: Mr. Bean, der Tollpatsch, der etwas unbeholfen durch die moderne Welt läuft!
overview.en: The simplest of daily tasks perplex and embarrass the beloved anti-hero, who always finds madcap, ingenious, and hilarious ways to solve his problems.
On her way to school, a teen rescues another student with deer-like antlers from a power line, marking the beginning of an unforgettable adventure.

After receiving a mysterious message from the cosmos, a deaf young woman journeys across a visually stunning steampunk world in search of her creator. With no words spoken and joined by a quirky group of unlikely allies, she embarks on an odyssey exploring faith, mortality, and the power of human connection in the space between life and death.

title.de: Naruto Geheimmission - Rettet das Dorf Takigakure
title.en: Naruto: The Lost Story - Mission: Protect the Waterfall Village!

overview.en: Hoping to honor his mother’s wishes, a young hustler plans to open up a brothel with his friends, but ruthless thugs have other plans.
A young man goes to great lengths to save his family from his greedy uncle in this period drama inspired by Charles Dickens's classic novel.

Veteran detective Tokita (Etsushi Toyokawa) and his partner Shiina (Tomoya Nakamura) are an unconventional duo assigned to an international drug-dealing investigation. Satomi (Yoshino Kimura) and Arira (Nana Seino) end up in a surprising state in the dispatch room. Meanwhile, Isayama (Goro Kishitani) and Ichijo (Amane Okayama) are criminals who have to deal with the cunning Mari (Yukino Kishii).
In Charles Dickens' classic tale, an orphan wends his way from a cruel apprenticeship to a den of thieves searching for a proper home.

title.de: Pettersson und Findus - Das schönste Weihnachten überhaupt
title.en: Pettson and Findus: The Best Christmas Ever

title.de: Phir Milenge - Bis wir uns wiedersehen

overview.en: A promising advertising executive, Tamanna Sahani, reconnects with an old crush, Rohit Manchanda, at their school reunion. The couple has a one-night stand, but any hope of a lasting relationship is tainted when Tamanna uncovers Rohit's secret -- he has AIDS, and now she also carries the virus. In addition to coping with HIV itself, Tamanna must contend with the disease's stigma, leading to both her firing and her subsequent lawsuit against her former company.
Hired gun and loudmouth Mowld repeatedly drags Phungus, an anxious little alien, from his cushy life as bartender into countless outlandish adventures.
Opposites attract when two very different friends of a married couple are asked to look after the couple's baby when the parents go out of town.
Set in the 1940s, the nostalgic story of an ordinary familiy in Queens, New York, is told alongside vignettes of radio's golden era of performers.
Rahul Subramanian's stand up comedy solo 'Kal Main Udega' is filled with unrelated topics, no transitions, inconsequential takes on consequential subjects and also a bit of mildly bad dancing.
Raju comes to Bombay chasing his dreams, but keeps losing out on opportunities. His love, Renu helps him find a job. Success goes to his head until one day a tragic accident destroys his reputation.

overview.de: Als ein Experiment schief geht, stiften Superkreaturen in der Stadt Chaos. Wissenschaftler Davis bemüht sich um ein Gegenmittel, um den Affen zu retten, der einst sein Freund war.
overview.en: When a genetic experiment goes awry, it unleashes super creatures that rampage the city. Scientist Davis races to secure an antidote to try to save the ape that was once his friend.
A widowed mom must protect her family when a demented stranger out for revenge turns their Christmas Day celebration into an over-the-top bloodbath.
A deadly warrior leads a senseless tribal war until he is betrayed and left for dead. A mysterious princess heals and revives him for a final battle.
Thongs and Octopus grow attached to the baby they kidnapped for their landlord, which leads to complications in handing the him over.
Set in the near future, an ex-jewel thief receives a gift from his son: a robot butler programmed to look after him. But soon the two companions try their luck as a heist team.

title.de: Rocky IV - Der Kampf des Jahrhunderts

overview.de: Kalter Krieg im Boxring, dazu Action satt. - Die Sowjets haben mit modernsten Methoden den Boxer Drago (Dolph Lundgren) zu einer wahren Kampfmaschine ausgebildet. In den USA tritt er im Ring gegen Rockys (Sylvester Stallone) Freund Apollo Creed (Carl Weathers) an und tötet ihn. In der UdSSR will es Rocky Drago heimzahlen.
overview.en: Champ Rocky Balboa trains in Siberia for a bout against a lab-tested Soviet with a 2000-psi punch.
A washed-up, offensive stand-up comedian falls in love with a punk rock singer - then succumbs to loneliness and self-destruction.
Sixteen-year-old teen Gwen becomes a pawn in a sinister conspiracy after accidentally discovering she inherited her family's talent for time travel.

Two realms exist in the land of Yanato: the Lofty Realm, where gods reside, and the Lowly Realm, where humans reside. Princess Sakuna was the daughter of the god of war and goddess of harvest, but she led a lazy life. One day, she is banished to Hinoe Island, the Isle of Demons. Stranded on a barren island, Sakuna sets out to slay demons and farm rice. Her new adventure begins!

title.de: Sar Ankhon Par - Die große Liebe

overview.en: A young wedding planner, Jagjinder Joginder (Shahid Kapoor), brings together Bipin Arora's flawed family in the backdrop of a destination wedding in London for his eldest daughter, while both the families try to save their empires. Will the Shaandar wedding succeed and also help the families save their dignifies empires.
A gangster goes to Hollywood to collect a debt and becomes a big-time producer when he realizes the movie business runs a lot like the mob.

title.de: Seaper Powers: Mystery of the Blue Pearls
title.en: Seaper Powers: Mystery of the Blue Pearls

overview.en: Emma works for NOAA as a diver and researcher. She is sent on a mission to find mysterious blue pearls in the deep Caribbean seas, but first she needs to call upon her octopus and starfish friends from her past to help.
Four young and handsome doctors undergo their clinical internship at a hospital and realize that their chosen profession is filled with challenges.

One day, Yuzuki is enveloped by a mysterious light suddenly emanating from her cell phone and finds herself in an unfamiliar place. 
The scenery spread out before her almost resembles Sengoku period Japan-- 
But this is another world known as "Shinga" where non-human creatures such as vampires and werewolves reside. 
 
Long ago, the various tribes of Shinga lived together peacefully unde...

Yuji Sakai learns there is more to the world than school and finding a girlfriend when he meets a sword-wielding girl with fiery red eyes and flame-colored hair. It's up to the Flame Haze, Shana, to slay the invading denizens of the Crimson Realm.

overview.de: Das gealterte TV-Sternchen Samantha Lake (Elisabeth Moss) spürt, wie ihr Ruhm und ihr Selbstbewusstsein verblassen. Als sie von der bahnbrechenden Anti-Aging-Technologie der charismatischen Unternehmerin Zoe Shannon (Kate Hudson) hört, wittert sie ihre Chance, an frühere Erfolge anzuknüpfen. Samantha lässt sich auf die exklusive Behandlung ein – doch je tiefer sie in die Welt ewiger Jugend eintaucht, desto klarer wird ihr: Schönheit hat ihren Preis.
overview.en: Desperate to reclaim her career, once-beloved actress Samantha Lake is drawn into the glamorous world of wellness mogul Zoe Shannon - only to uncover a monstrous truth beneath its flawless surface.

Zia (Bhumika Chawla) is an actress who is disillusioned with her lover and mentor, Neel (Rahul Bose). Anushka (Riya Sen) is engaged to a wealthy man, but longs for tenderness. And Rehana (Tabu) has to deal with the reality of an unfaithful husband.

title.de: Sinister - Wenn Du ihn siehst, bist Du schon verloren

overview.en: True crime novelist Ellison Oswald is so desperate to repeat the success of his first book that he moves his family into a home that served as the setting of a brutal murder. But instead of inspiration, Ellison finds a box of mysterious home movies in the attic that seem to point to unspeakable terrors -- ones that could threaten his entire family.
Chronicles the married life of the young empress as she tries to adjust to formal and strict rules in the palace, and an overbearing mother-in-law.

title.de: Snoopy präsentiert: Zu Hause ist es am schönsten
title.en: Snoopy Presents: There's No Place Like Home, Snoopy

overview.de: Als Snoopys geliebte Hundehütte plötzlich verschwindet, setzt er alles daran, sie wiederzufinden und erkennt auf seiner Suche, was ein Haus wirklich zu einem Zuhause macht.
overview.en: When Snoopy’s beloved doghouse goes missing, he tries to track it down, and learns what makes a house feel like home.
Following an accident, an astronaut mining engineer must push himself to the limit to survive as his escape pod idles helplessly towards the Sun.

Explores Vienna's 150-year history as a global hub for espionage, from 1873 to modern intelligence operations. Directed by Dr. Boris Volodarsky, it features expert interviews, dramatizations, and cutting-edge effects. The film uncovers key espionage events, like Colonel Alfred Redl's betrayal, and highlights Vienna's ongoing role in global intelligence.
Five years after their son’s death, a family is swept into a dark mystery when his old girlfriend appears to tell them she’s pregnant with his baby.

Dawood, Gangsters, Mayyat and Rahul, these are few of the many things stand-up comedian Sumaira Shaikh talks about in her first stand-up special DONGRI DANGER. Born in the gullies of Mumbai 9, Sumaira’s dark observations on what is your rank in your friend's group, how tsunami’s are the best relaxation videos and how her father once met Dawood, will leave you in splits and make you uncomfortable.
En una noche dominada por el alcohol, cuatro amigos deciden cambiar de pareja, lo que tiene consecuencias para su amistad y sus relaciones.
A suburban couple decides to shake up their dull and boring marriage by swinging with another couple facing similar marital issues.
The stubborn son of a Cossack chieftain who has vowed to fight to the death to regain his lands from Polish invaders is torn between family and love.
A workaholic must outwit his multiplying clones after a magical tequila travels him back in time – again and again – in order to make things right with his couple.

overview.de: Ein scheinbar unzerstörbarer Android wird aus dem Jahr 2029 nach 1984 gesandt, um eine Kellnerin zu töten, deren ungeborener Sohn die Menschheit in einen Kampf gegen Maschinen führen wird. Gleichzeitig wird ein Kriegssoldat zu ihrem Schutz einberufen.
overview.en: A cyborg assassin travels back in time to kill a woman whose unborn son will lead humanity’s fight against machines in a desperate race to survive.
Searching for her father, Maddy and her friends find the monstrous birds that killed him and the ambitious scientist protecting them from extinction.
After learning that a brain aneurysm will kill him in about 90 minutes, a perpetually unhappy man struggles to come to terms with his fate and make amends with everyone he has ever hurt.
Released from prison, a man reunites with his brother, who tries to help him, but a love triangle leads to a battle of Cain and Abel proportions

overview.de: Als eine lesbische Bestsellerautorin von Weihnachtsromanen von einer Schreibblockade geplagt wird, kehrt sie in ihre Heimatstadt zurück, um Inspiration zu finden - und findet sie in Gestalt einer charmanten alleinerziehenden Mutter, der die örtliche Buchhandlung gehört.
overview.en: When a bestselling lesbian Christmas author is paralyzed by writer's block, she returns to her hometown searching for inspiration, and finds it in the form of a charming single mom who owns the local bookstore, forcing her to choose between the life she built and the love she never saw coming.
To protect his father’s discovery, a boy and his friends go on an epic adventure to find a piece of the comet that crashed near their hometown.

One night two people's worlds changes forever as a mysterious light in the woods connects the two in a way far beyond their understanding. As they set out to get their lives back to normal, they find the connection is the only normal they may ever know again.

title.de: The Covenant - Das Böse ist hier

overview.en: After the tragic deaths of her husband and daughter, Sarah Doyle descends into madness and is possessed by a powerful and violent demon. Her desperate brother enlists the help of an Exorcist and a paranormal investigator in order to save her soul.
A widowed mother desperately races against time to save her son when a shooting at his school prompts authorities to place her small town on lockdown.

overview.de: Sir Gawain (Dev Patel), König Arthurs eigensinniger Neffe, nimmt als Ritter der Tafelrunde mutig und unerschrocken eine unglaubliche Herausforderung an: ein Duell mit einem mysteriösen, gigantischen und smaragdfarbenen Fremden, bekannt als The Green Knight. So muss Gawain auf seiner epischen Reise mit Geistern, Riesen, Dieben und Intriganten kämpfen, um sich selbst zu finden und seinen Heldenmut vor Familie und Königreich zu beweisen, indem er sich dem ultimativen Herausforderer stellt. Wird Sir Gawain den finalen Triumph erleben oder wird er untergehen?
overview.en: An epic adventure based on the Arthurian legend that recounts the story of Sir Gawain, Kings Arthur's headstrong nephew, who embarks on a quest to confront the Green Knight, a half-tree, half-human strange giant.

title.de: The King’s Speech - Die Rede des Königs

overview.de: Colin Firth sucht als stotternder König Hilfe bei einem Sprachtherapeuten, um sein Volk in einer Rede auf den Krieg gegen Hitler einzustimmen. Mit viel Witz erzähltes Historiendrama. Vier Oscars! - Öffentliche Auftritte geraten dem Herzog von York (Colin Firth) zum Fiasko: Er stottert. Sprachtherapeut Logue (Geoffrey Rush) soll helfen. Die Dienste des respektlosen Zungenklempners werden immer dringender gebraucht: 1937 wird der Herzog neuer König von England. Und nicht nur die Krönung will ohne zu stottern bestanden sein. Der König muss sein Volk bald unfallfrei auf den Krieg gegen Hitler einstimmen.
overview.en:
After the death of his father King George V (Michael Gambon) and the scandalous abdication of King Edward VIII (Guy Pearce), Bertie (Colin Firth) who has suffered from a debilitating speech impediment all his life, is suddenly crowned King George VI of England. With his country on the brink of war and in desperate need of a leader, his wife, Elizabeth (Helena Bonham Carter), the future Queen Mother, arranges for her husband to see an eccentric speech therapist, Lionel Logue (Geoffrey Rush). After a rough start, the two delve into an unorthodox course of treatment and eventually form an unbreakable bond. With the support of Logue, his family, his government and Winston Churchill (Timothy Spall), the King will overcome his stammer and deliver a radio-address that inspires his people and unites them in battle. 
Based on the true story of King George VI, The King's Speech follows the Royal Monarch's quest to find his voice.
Un oficial de la policía se hace pasar por prisionero en una corrupta prisión mortal donde una pandilla de mercenarios hace de las suyas.
During the Vietnam War, a determined music promoter discovers the amazing vocal stylings of four talented Australian Aboriginal women.

title.de: The Stand: How One Gesture Shook the World
title.en: The Stand: How One Gesture Shook the World

overview.en: Track and field stars Tommie Smith and John Carlos stand up against racism during the 1968 Olympics.
A self-absorbed musician and starving artist reconsiders the part he played in his failed marriage after his daughter announces her own engagement.

Clark dreams of becoming a famous screenwriter. When a big Hollywood movie begins filming in his quaint hometown, he sneaks his way onto the movie set. Clark finds himself face-to-face with the movie's star, Helena Harris. The two begin to fall for each other and she offers to help him achieve his dream. However, things become complicated by the return of Emily, Clark's high school sweetheart.
A driven radio presenter and a freewheeling tech entrepreneur find unexpected romance when his new dating app matches them live on her show.
In a post-apocalyptic city, cannibals hunt a group of survivors who have been hiding in an abandoned building, planning their attack.

overview.de: Kate Cooper, Tyler Owens und ihre konkurrierenden Teams befinden sich zwischen gleich mehreren Monsterstürmen, die über Zentral-Oklahoma zusammentreffen. Es wird der Kampf ihres Lebens.
overview.en: Kate and Tyler, rival storm chasers with distinct styles, race to survive an unprecedented outbreak of destructive tornados.
This film is the inspirational story of the '09 Abilene High School Football team, who fought to beat the odds and win their state championship.
Después de inventar un dispositivo que puede leer la mente de los prisioneros, una científica lo usa contra un presunto asesino en serie vicioso.
The anime series about a 30-year-old bachelor who learns to become a family man and parent when he takes in his six-year-old distant relative.

title.en: The Return of the Living Dead

overview.en: While working at a medical supply company, two employees release a gas that raises the dead, causing the town to be overrun with flesh-eating zombies.
When his only son disappears from a campsite, Edmond Murray travels to the town where his ex-wife lives in search of answers.
Updated to the modern day, this take on the beloved classic follows the March sisters from girls playing in the attic to women living with purpose.
A virus spreads throughout the city, causing the infected to become vicious hunters. Iris and her daughter become caught in the massacre, discovering 32-second periods of calm before each attack.

Explore the history of the American LGBTQ movement through the lens of TV in this five-part docuseries. Combining archival footage with new interviews, the series looks at homophobia, the evolution of LGBTQ characters, and coming out in the TV world.
Carlo Verdone portrays the drama and comedy of a career in the limelight, a frugal private life, and his relationships.

Five young people get to know each other at the casting for a musical: Paula, Louise, Randolf, Max and Donnie. Randolf falls in love with Louise. But she's more interested in Donnie, while something is about to happen between Paula and Max. Paula wants to save her acting career at the casting, but the options for a professional and private new start cause a lot of chaos.
Two female warriors with exceptional fighting skills journey across a post-apocalyptic land to fight a ritual duel and fulfill an ancient prophecy.
When his father retires and attempts to pass the throne to his son, a young man must choose between his family's legacy and his lavish lifestyle.
A modern London woman obsessed with the romance in Jane Austen’s work discovers that she’s switched lives with a character from Pride & Prejudice.

title.de: Wie bringt man seine Frau um?

overview.en: A rich bachelor finds his swinging lifestyle ruined when he awakens one morning having married the gorgeous lady who popped out of a cake.

A Hallmark Channel original movie. When Hanna, a travel agent up for a promotion is directed to forgo her tropical vacation to instead visit the world-famous Ice Hotel, she discovers her sacrifices are more than compensated when she meets Ben, the designer and co-owner. As they spend more and more time together, Hanna starts thinking of her old dream of running her own hotel...and if the future includes Ben.
Following a failed bank robbery, a group of thieves take refuge in a strange forest inhabited by a group of cannibalistic witches in this wild thrill ride.
After her bad review of a Chicago eatery goes viral, a Tribune food critic attempts to make amends by going undercover as its chef’s new prep cook.
Prep school English teacher Jack Marcus (Clive Owen) meets his match in Dina Delsanto (Juliette Binoche) — an abstract painter and the new art teacher on campus.

This touching fantasy tale reimagines the origins of Santa Claus as a young orphan named Nikolas, who decides to show his gratitude to the villagers who raised him by starting the Christmas tradition of gift-giving.

China, 1862: Lord Lindsey rules the opium trade and enslaves the innocent. The only hope for the oppressed nation is a covert group of trained Wushu Warriors - The Red Lotus Society - who will fight to restore justice to its people.
Introverted Masha feels like an outsider, except with her non-conformist friends, Yana and Senia, as they navigate the emotional turmoil of youth.

Dhungya and Dhairya top the junior college exam, but Kabir drops out of the college, and continues his higher education abroad. He breaks off their friendship and challenges his old friends to visit him in London to settle the score. Dhungya and Dhairya get their chance to do exactly that, as part of the foreign cultural exchange program.

A passionate traffic police who is bored of his routine job stumbles across some skeletons which ignite his soulless life. When he probes into the case he comes across a cop who had investigated the case in the past.

Dharka and Brahma Jois Fight Over the Trishanku Mani in a battle of mantras and soon after Brahma Jois turns up dead. Prior to his Death in order to protect his family he deployed the Ashta Digbandhana and hides the Trishanku Mani in his house. Will Dharka find it?

Rathnan Prapancha is a Travel Dramedy that tells the tale of Ratnakara, an average middle class guy in his late twenties. Unlike his peers who’re already settled and are exploring other avenues in their lives, he’s stuck in a house with an unwanted companion; his mother, Saroja. Just when things couldn’t get any worse Ratnakara gets a phone call that turns his life upside down.

Super Star Hareendran is Well Known for his Driving Skills and Craze towards Motor Cars. Kuruvila Joseph, the Motor Vehicle Inspector of the Town is a Die Hard Fan of Hareendran. To complete the shoot of his latest film Hareendran needs to submit his license, which he discovers is missing. In order to get a new license urgently, Hareendran goes to Kuruvilla, his biggest fan.

Two cinema enthusiasts from a religious organization decide to make a movie in accordance to the religious understanding of permissible and forbidden. They find an experienced crew from the mainstream but they have reservations on the cast of the lead couple. The couple has to be married to each other so that behaving closer to each can be religiously permissible.

overview.en: "Heaven's Door!" – with these words, manga artist Kishibe Rohan turns people into “books” to learn their secrets and write in additional instructions. Rohan must summon all his powers to face down the peculiar incidents that come his way. Based on the popular spinoff of Jojo's Bizarre Adventure by Araki Hirohiko.©LUCKY LAND COMMUNICATIONS / SHUEISHA ©NHK / P.I.C.S.

Hotshot Saichi Nagase is Tosaka Real Estate’s top realtor. He lies through his teeth and will stop at nothing to seal a deal. One day, he disturbs a monument located at a construction site. Cursed with the inability to tell a lie, he is forced to run his mouth off with things that are better left unsaid. With so many angry clients, he's got no hope of surviving as an honest realtor.

Yukisuke is attracted to a girl Koyomi, who runs a small stand of taiyaki pastry that he often buys. Koyomi is hospitalized, however, by a car accident on a rainy day after they go out together, and wakes up with short term memory loss, where she cannot remember anything beyond the present day. Yukisuke tries to live close to her as before but the lack of collective memory starts to stagger him.

title.en: LOL: Chi ride è fuori - Halloween Special

overview.de: Der 13-jährige Connor leidet sehr unter der Krebserkrankung seiner Mutter und zieht sich jede Nacht in seine Fantasiewelt zurück, um sich mit ihrem bevorstehenden Tod auseinanderzusetzen. Immer exakt sieben Minuten nach Mitternacht zeigt sich ihm ein Ungeheuer in der Figur eines Baumes. Das Wesen nimmt Connor mit auf eine Reise und erzählt ihm Geschichten, deren Moral den Jungen dazu zwingt, sich mit seinen eigenen Ängsten zu konfrontieren.
overview.en: HD. A boy faced with the loss of his mother is guided by an unexpected visitor: a monster who tells him a trio of stories.

An urban legend is re-enacted as three teenage girls mysteriously disappear on homecoming night. The next day they resurface with no memory of their disappearance. Those responsible for the prank begin to be killed off one by one in urban legend fashion while one of the homecoming girls and her brother must solve the mystery behind the murders and it's connection to the past before it's too late.

Based on Erich Kästner’s classic children’s novel. Martina takes up a scholarship at the Johann-Sigismund Gymnasium boarding school. She finds herself caught between the rivalry between the boarders and the “externals” from the local village.

title.de: Clashing Through the Snow – Ein Weihnachts-Roadtrip

overview.de: From ist das Mysterium einer albtraumhaften Stadt, die alle gefangen hält, die sie betreten. Die unfreiwilligen Einwohner müssen einen Sinn für Normalität bewahren, einen Ausweg suchen und die Bedrohungen des umgebenden Waldes überleben.
overview.en: The closer the residents of town get to the answers they seek, the more terrifying their search becomes. Who is the Man in Yellow, and what does he want? Will Jade and Tabitha's revelation be the key to finally going home?

Grammy nominated comedian Nate Bargatze delivers his family friendly take on a variety of topics including disadvantages of being the first born, the challenges of playing golf with your wife, and what happens when a bald eagle touches your head.

overview.de: Ein Junge bricht bei seinem neuen Haustier versehentlich drei wichtige Regeln und setzt dadurch eine Horde von übelwollenden, spitzbübischen Monstern in einer Kleinstadt frei.
overview.en: Some furry and not-so-cute little creatures besiege a small town after a young man ignores the warnings of a wise elder regarding their care and feeding.

overview.de: Für Peter Parker beginnt ein neuer Lebensabschnitt. Der Vollzeitkampf gegen das Verbrechen als Spider-Man, sowie der Druck, mitanzusehen, wie seine alten Freunde ohne ihn weitermachen, lösen in Peter eine Veränderung aus. Doch diese Verwandlung könnte das Einzige sein, was eine neue, unsichtbare Bedrohung für die Stadt und die Menschen, die er liebt, aufhalten kann.
overview.en: A powerful change in Peter may be the only thing that can stop a shocking new threat to the city.

title.de: Toos: De van der valk ontvoering
title.en: Toos: The Van der Valk Kidnapping

overview.en: A group of queer best friends gather in Fire Island Pines for their annual week of love and laughter, but a sudden change of events might make this their last summer in gay paradise.

overview.de: Die Welt brauchte einen Helden - sie bekam einen Igel. Unfassbar schnell rast Sonic dahin, um die Erde vor der Herrschaft des bösen Genies Dr. Robotnik zu retten. Jim Carrey, Ben Schwartz und James Marsden in einem Abenteuer für die ganze Familie.
overview.en: Sonic races across the globe to stop evil genius Dr. Robotnik from achieving world domination.
